key: Kamra Agent runs on your own AI account. It takes about two minutes.
english: Kamra Agent runs on your own AI account. It takes about two minutes.
arabic: يعمل Kamra Agent على حساب الذكاء الاصطناعي الخاص بك. يستغرق الأمر دقيقتين تقريبا.
spanish: Kamra Agent utiliza su propia cuenta de IA. La configuración tarda unos dos minutos.
portuguese: O Agente Kamra é executado em sua própria conta de IA. Demora cerca de dois minutos.
chinese: Kamra 智能助手运行于你自己的 AI 账户，约需两分钟。

key: Kamra POSTs a signed JSON event to each endpoint. Failed deliveries are retried for about 8 hours.
english: Kamra POSTs a signed JSON event to each endpoint. Failed deliveries are retried for about 8 hours.
arabic: يرسل Kamra حدث JSON موقعا بطلب POST إلى كل نقطة نهاية. يُعاد إرسال ما فشل لمدة 8 ساعات تقريبا.
spanish: Kamra envía un evento JSON firmado a cada endpoint. Los envíos fallidos se reintentan durante unas ocho horas.
portuguese: Kamra POSTs um evento JSON assinado para cada endpoint. As entregas com falha são repetidas por cerca de 8 horas.
chinese: Kamra 会向各端点 POST 签名 JSON 事件。投递失败会在约 8 小时内重试。

key: Kamra sends the ticket straight to the printer's network address. Only works when the Kamra server is on the same network as the printer, not on a cloud server.
english: Kamra sends the ticket straight to the printer's network address. Only works when the Kamra server is on the same network as the printer, not on a cloud server.
arabic: يرسل Kamra التذكرة مباشرة إلى عنوان الطابعة على الشبكة. يعمل فقط عندما يكون خادم Kamra على نفس شبكة الطابعة، وليس على خادم سحابي.
spanish: Kamra envía la comanda directamente a la dirección de red de la impresora. Esto solo funciona si el servidor de Kamra está en la misma red que la impresora; no funciona con un servidor en la nube.
portuguese: O Kamra envia a comanda diretamente para o endereço de rede da impressora. Funciona apenas quando o servidor Kamra está na mesma rede local da impressora.
chinese: Kamra 直接将单据发送到打印机的网络地址。仅当 Kamra 服务器与打印机在同一网络时可用，云服务器不可用。

key: Kamra Verify checks this tax ID with the tax network. Charged per check to your Kamra Connect wallet.
english: Kamra Verify checks this tax ID with the tax network. Charged per check to your Kamra Connect wallet.
arabic: يتحقق Kamra Verify من هذا الرقم الضريبي عبر الشبكة الضريبية. يُخصم كل فحص من محفظة Kamra Connect.
spanish: Kamra Verify comprueba esta identificación fiscal con la red tributaria. Cada verificación se cobra a su saldo de Kamra Connect.
portuguese: Kamra Verify verifica este ID fiscal com a rede tributária. Cobrado por cheque em sua carteira Kamra Connect.
chinese: Kamra 验证会通过税务网络核验此税号，按次从 Kamra Connect 钱包扣费。

key: Kamra Verify reads the ID and fills the profile. Charged per read to your Kamra Connect wallet.
english: Kamra Verify reads the ID and fills the profile. Charged per read to your Kamra Connect wallet.
arabic: يقرأ Kamra Verify الهوية ويملأ الملف. تُخصم كل قراءة من محفظة Kamra Connect.
spanish: Kamra Verify lee el documento de identidad y completa el perfil. Cada lectura se cobra a su saldo de Kamra Connect.
portuguese: Kamra Verify lê o ID e preenche o perfil. Cobrado por leitura em sua carteira Kamra Connect.
chinese: Kamra 验证会读取证件并填入资料，按次从 Kamra Connect 钱包扣费。

key: Kamra warns you before the hold date if the group has used fewer rooms than agreed.
english: Kamra warns you before the hold date if the group has used fewer rooms than agreed.
portuguese: O sistema alerta antes da data limite se o grupo estiver utilizando menos quartos que o acordado.
chinese: 若团队使用的客房少于约定，Kamra 会在保留日期前提醒。

key: Kamra will create a whole-property sellable unit for each listing. You can add physical rooms later for housekeeping if needed.
english: Kamra will create a whole-property sellable unit for each listing. You can add physical rooms later for housekeeping if needed.
arabic: ستنشئ كامرا وحدة قابلة للبيع للعقار بالكامل لكل قائمة. يمكنك إضافة غرف فعلية لاحقاً للتدبير المنزلي إن لزم.
spanish: Kamra creará una unidad reservable de alojamiento completo por cada alojamiento publicado. Si lo necesita, después podrá agregar sus habitaciones físicas para gestionar la limpieza.
portuguese: Kamra criará uma unidade vendável de propriedade inteira para cada listagem. Você pode adicionar quartos físicas posteriormente para limpeza, se necessário.
chinese: Kamra 会为每个房源创建整栋可售单元。如需客房清洁管理，可稍后添加实体客房。

key: Keep charged nights: charged nights keep their rate, only the nights still to come take the new one; give any difference back as an allowance. Credit the difference: when the new rate is lower, Kamra posts a credit for each charged night, dated today. Correct back-dated rates: as Keep, plus Finance or a Hotel Admin can correct charged nights to the current rate with a reason and their PIN; each night is reversed and posted again.
english: Keep charged nights: charged nights keep their rate, only the nights still to come take the new one; give any difference back as an allowance. english: Occupancy on the books, next 90 days
chinese: 未来 90 天已订入住率

key: Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue and collections for a day, with the month to date.
english: Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue and collections for a day, with the month to date.
arabic: الإشغال ومتوسط السعر والإيراد لكل غرفة متاحة والإيرادات والتحصيلات ليوم، مع الشهر حتى اليوم.
spanish: Ocupación, ADR, RevPAR, ingresos y cobros de un día, con el mes a la fecha.
portuguese: Ocupação, diária média (ADR), receita por quarto (RevPAR), receitas e cobranças do dia, com o acumulado do mês.
chinese: 单日入住率、平均每日房价、每间可售房收入、收入与收款，含本月至今。

key: Off = thrown in as standard. It still prints on the event order and the pack list; any function can override it.
english: Off = thrown in as standard. It still prints on the event order and the pack list; any function can override it.
arabic: إيقاف = مشمول ضمن الأساسي. يُطبع مع ذلك على أمر المناسبة وقائمة التجهيز، ويمكن لأي مناسبة تجاوزه.
spanish: Desactivado = se incluye sin cargo. Aun así aparece en la orden del evento y la lista de materiales; se puede cambiar en cada evento.
portuguese: Desligado = lançado como padrão. Ainda é impresso na ordem do evento e na lista de pacotes; qualquer função pode substituí-lo.
chinese: 关闭 = 作为标准配置赠送。仍会打印在宴会执行单与报表包上；各活动可单独覆盖。

key: Off for a dry property: every alcohol field, tick box and label is hidden, in every language. Nothing posted before changes.
english: Off for a dry property: every alcohol field, tick box and label is hidden, in every language. Nothing posted before changes.
arabic: أوقفه لمنشأة لا تقدم الكحول: تُخفى كل حقول الكحول وخاناته وتسمياته بكل اللغات. لا يتغير شيء مما قُيّد سابقًا.
spanish: Desactívelo en una propiedad sin alcohol: se ocultan todos los campos, casillas y etiquetas de alcohol, en todos los idiomas. Nada de lo ya cargado cambia.
portuguese: Desligue em uma propriedade sem bebida alcoólica: todos os campos, caixas e rótulos de bebida alcoólica ficam ocultos, em todos os idiomas. Nada do que já foi lançado muda.
chinese: 无酒水酒店请关闭：所有酒水字段、勾选框与标签将在各语言下隐藏。此前入账的数据不受影响。

key: Off: nobody can connect an AI client to this property, and existing connections stop working.
english: Off: nobody can connect an AI client to this property, and existing connections stop working.
arabic: إيقاف: لا يمكن لأحد ربط عميل ذكاء اصطناعي بهذا العقار، وتتوقف الاتصالات الحالية عن العمل.
spanish: Desactivado: nadie puede conectar un cliente de IA a este alojamiento y las conexiones existentes dejan de funcionar.
portuguese: Desativado: ninguém pode conectar um cliente de IA a esta propriedade e as conexões existentes param de funcionar.
chinese: 关闭：无人可将 AI 客户端连接到本酒店，已有连接将失效。

key: Off: the scheduler never closes this property; staff close the day from End of Day.
english: Off: the scheduler never closes this property; staff close the day from End of Day.
arabic: عند الإيقاف: لا يغلق المجدول هذه المنشأة أبدًا؛ يغلق الموظفون اليوم من نهاية اليوم.
spanish: Desactivado: el programador nunca cierra esta propiedad; el personal cierra el día desde Cierre del día.
portuguese: Desligado: o agendador nunca fecha esta propriedade; a equipe fecha o dia em Fim do Dia.
chinese: 关闭：计划任务不会自动日结；员工需在「日结」中手动关闭。

spanish: En un dispositivo de cocina, abra
portuguese: Em um dispositivo de cozinha, abra

key: On the food and the people serving it, not the hall
english: On the food and the people serving it, not the hall
arabic: على الطعام وطاقم الخدمة، لا على القاعة
spanish: Sobre los alimentos y el personal de servicio, sin incluir el salón
portuguese: Da comida e das pessoas que a servem, não do salão
chinese: 针对餐饮与服务人员，不含场地

key: On: a guest still Checked In past their departure date is extended by one night when the audit runs, and that night is posted like any other. A stay that can't be extended (the room is booked) stays on the checklist.
english: On: a guest still Checked In past their departure date is extended by one night when the audit runs, and that night is posted like any other. A stay that can't be extended (the room is booked) stays on the checklist.
arabic: مفعّل: يُمدَّد الضيف الذي ما زال مقيمًا بعد تاريخ مغادرته ليلة واحدة عند تشغيل التدقيق، وتُرحَّل تلك الليلة كغيرها. الإقامة التي لا يمكن تمديدها (الغرفة محجوزة) تبقى في قائمة التدقيق.
spanish: Activado: un huésped que sigue alojado después de su fecha de salida se extiende una noche al correr la auditoría, y esa noche se carga como cualquier otra. Una estancia que no se puede extender (la habitación está reservada) queda en la lista de verificación.
portuguese: Ligado: um hóspede ainda hospedado após a data de saída é estendido por uma diária quando o fechamento roda, e essa diária é lançada como qualquer outra. Uma estadia que não pode ser estendida (o quarto está reservado) fica na lista de verificação.
chinese: 开启：夜审运行时，已过离店日期仍为已入住的住店将自动延长一晚，并按常规入账该晚。无法延长的住店（客房已被预订）会留在检查清单中。

key: On: sending an order prints the KOT and shows it on the kitchen display as started, so nobody presses Start. Off: the kitchen presses Start and each till chooses whether to print. An outlet can override this on its own record.
english: On: sending an order prints the KOT and shows it on the kitchen display as started, so nobody presses Start. Off: the kitchen presses Start and each till chooses whether to print. An outlet can override this on its own record.
arabic: تشغيل: إرسال الطلب يطبع أمر المطبخ ويظهره على شاشة المطبخ كمبدوء، فلا يحتاج أحد للضغط على بدء. إيقاف: يضغط المطبخ بدء ويختار كل صندوق ما إذا كان سيطبع. يمكن للمنفذ تجاوز ذلك في سجله الخاص.
spanish: Activado: enviar el pedido imprime la comanda y la marca como iniciada en cocina. Desactivado: cocina debe pulsar Iniciar y cada caja decide si imprime. Cada punto de venta puede cambiar esta opción en su configuración.
portuguese: Ligado: o envio de um pedido imprime o KOT e o mostra no display da cozinha como iniciado, para que ninguém pressione Iniciar. Desligado: a cozinha pressiona Iniciar e cada caixa escolhe se deseja imprimir. Um ponto de venda pode substituir isso no próprio cadastro.
chinese: 开启：下单即打印厨房单并在厨房屏显示为已开始，无需人工点击开始。关闭：由厨房点击开始，各钱箱自行选择是否打印。营业点可在自身记录中覆盖。

key: On: staff open their till (with an opening float) before taking or giving back money, and close it with a cash count. Off, for a small place with no cash drawer: payments and refunds are recorded without a till.
english: On: staff open their till (with an opening float) before taking or giving back money, and close it with a cash count. Off, for a small place with no cash drawer: payments and refunds are recorded without a till.
arabic: تشغيل: يفتح الموظفون صندوقهم (برصيد افتتاحي) قبل استلام الأموال أو ردها، ويغلقونه بعد عدّ النقد. إيقاف، للمنشآت الصغيرة بلا درج نقدي: تُسجل الدفعات والمبالغ المستردة بدون صندوق.
spanish: Activado: el personal abre su caja con un fondo inicial antes de cobrar o reembolsar y la cierra con un recuento. Desactivado: para alojamientos pequeños sin caja física, permite registrar pagos y reembolsos sin caja.
portuguese: Ativado: a equipe abre o caixa (com um fundo de troco inicial) antes de receber ou devolver valores e o fecha com a conferência de caixa. Desativado para estabelecimentos sem gaveta de dinheiro: pagamentos e reembolsos são registrados sem controle de caixa.
chinese: 开启：员工收款或退款前需开启钱箱（含期初备用金），结束时清点关闭。关闭（适用于无现金抽屉的小型场所）：收款与退款无需钱箱即可记录。

key: One advance for the whole trip
english: One advance for the whole trip
spanish: Un solo anticipo para todo el viaje
portuguese: Um único adiantamento para toda a viagem

key: One consolidated company bill across every room of the group
english: One consolidated company bill across every room of the group
arabic: فاتورة شركة موحّدة عبر كل غرف المجموعة
spanish: Una sola cuenta de empresa para todas las habitaciones del grupo
portuguese: Uma fatura corporativa consolidada para todos os quartos do grupo
chinese: 团队各客房合并为一张公司账单

key: One listing for the whole property. No room numbers required.
english: One listing for the whole property. No room numbers required.
arabic: قائمة واحدة للعقار بالكامل. لا حاجة لأرقام غرف.
spanish: Un alojamiento completo por anuncio. No se requieren números de habitación.
portuguese: Um anúncio para toda a propriedade. Não são necessários números de quartos.
chinese: 整个酒店一个房源页面，无需房号。

key: One open session per cashier per business date. Set the float in the drawer, then open.
english: One open session per cashier per business date. Set the float in the drawer, then open.
arabic: جلسة مفتوحة واحدة لكل أمين صندوق في كل تاريخ عمل. ضع الرصيد الابتدائي في الدرج، ثم افتح.
spanish: Solo puede haber una sesión abierta por cajero y fecha operativa. Ingrese el fondo inicial del cajón y abra la sesión.
portuguese: Uma sessão aberta por operador de caixa por data contábil. Informe o fundo de troco na gaveta e abra o caixa.
chinese: 每位收银员每个营业日只能有一个开启的班次。先在抽屉中放入备用金，再开启。

key: One page per department. You see the parts your role can open.
english: One page per department. You see the parts your role can open.
arabic: صفحة واحدة لكل قسم. ترى الأجزاء التي يسمح بها دورك.
spanish: Una página por departamento. Verá las partes que su rol puede abrir.
portuguese: Uma página por departamento. Você vê as partes que sua função pode abrir.
chinese: 每个部门一页。仅显示你的角色可访问的部分。

key: One per line. Serving order on the kitchen display (starters before mains).
english: One per line. Serving order on the kitchen display (starters before mains).
arabic: واحد في كل سطر. ترتيب التقديم على شاشة المطبخ (المقبلات قبل الأطباق الرئيسية).
spanish: Uno por línea. Orden de servicio en cocina: entradas antes de platos principales.
portuguese: Um por linha. Ordem de serviço no display da cozinha (entradas antes da alimentação).
chinese: 每行一个。厨房屏上的出菜顺序（前菜先于主菜）。

key: One per line. Shown as chips on each menu item (Egg, Nuts, …). Matched against the guest's allergy note on the kitchen display.
english: One per line. Shown as chips on each menu item (Egg, Nuts, …). Matched against the guest's allergy note on the kitchen display.
arabic: واحد في كل سطر. تظهر كشارات على كل صنف (بيض، مكسرات، …). تُقارن بملاحظة حساسية الضيف على شاشة المطبخ.
spanish: Uno por línea. Aparecen como etiquetas en cada plato (huevo, frutos secos…). Se comparan con las alergias del huésped en cocina.
portuguese: Um por linha. Mostrados como fichas em cada item do menu (Ovo, Nozes,…). Comparado com a nota de alergia do hóspede na vitrine da cozinha.
chinese: 每行一项。作为标签显示在各菜单项上（鸡蛋、坚果…）。厨房屏会与客人过敏备注比对。

key: One per line. Suggestions when typing a category on a menu item - free text still allowed.
english: One per line. Suggestions when typing a category on a menu item - free text still allowed.
arabic: واحد في كل سطر. اقتراحات عند كتابة فئة على صنف القائمة، والنص الحر مسموح أيضا.
spanish: Una por línea. Sugerencias de categoría al agregar artículos al menú; también se permite texto libre.
portuguese: Um por linha. Sugestões ao digitar uma categoria em um item de menu - texto livre ainda é permitido.
chinese: 每行一项。在菜单项中输入分类时的建议项 - 仍允许自由输入。

key: One per line. Which KOT a dish prints to, and how the kitchen display groups tickets.
english: One per line. Which KOT a dish prints to, and how the kitchen display groups tickets.
arabic: واحد في كل سطر. يحدد أمر المطبخ الذي يُطبع عليه الطبق، وكيف تجمع شاشة المطبخ التذاكر.
spanish: Una por línea. Determinan dónde se imprime la comanda de cada plato y cómo se agrupan las comandas en cocina.
portuguese: Uma por linha. Em qual KOT um prato é impresso e como o display da cozinha agrupa as comandas.
chinese: 每行一项。决定菜品厨房单的打印去向，以及厨房屏如何分组单据。

key: One printer is set up per station. Connect the physical printers later under Printers.
english: One printer is set up per station. Connect the physical printers later under Printers.
arabic: تُعد طابعة واحدة لكل محطة. اربط الطابعات الفعلية لاحقا ضمن الطابعات.
spanish: Se configura una impresora por estación. Conecte las impresoras físicas más tarde en Impresoras.
portuguese: Uma impressora é configurada por estação. Conecte as impressoras físicas posteriormente em Impressoras.
chinese: 每个工作站配置一台打印机。稍后可在「打印机」中连接实体打印机。

key: One row per balance. Type is In-house (what the guest owes; negative if in credit, 0 if settled), City ledger (an unpaid company bill; negative for cash paid in advance) or Deposit (an advance paid for a future reservation). Use the last night audit's closing numbers from the old system.
english: One row per balance. Type is In-house (what the guest owes; negative if in credit, 0 if settled), City ledger (an unpaid company bill; negative for cash paid in advance) or Deposit (an advance paid for a future reservation). Use the last night audit's closing numbers from the old system.
portuguese: Uma linha por saldo. O tipo é Hospedado (saldo devedor do hóspede), Faturado/City Ledger (fatura de empresa a receber) ou Depósito (sinal antecipado para reserva futura). Use os saldos do fechamento anterior.
chinese: 每个余额一行。类型为在住（客人欠款；贷方为负，结清为 0）、应收账户（未付公司账单；预付现金为负）或押金（为未来预订支付的预付款）。请使用旧系统最后一次夜审的期末数据。

key: One row per balance. Type is In-house (what the guest owes; negative if in credit, 0 if settled), City ledger (an unpaid company invoice; negative for money paid ahead) or Deposit (an advance a future booking has paid). Use the closing figures from the old system's last night audit.
english: One row per balance. Type is In-house (what the guest owes; negative if in credit, 0 if settled), City ledger (an unpaid company invoice; negative for money paid ahead) or Deposit (an advance a future booking has paid). Use the closing figures from the old system's last night audit.
arabic: صف واحد لكل رصيد. النوع إما داخل الفندق (ما يدين به الضيف، سالب إن كان له رصيد دائن، و0 إن كان مسددا)، أو دفتر المدينة (فاتورة شركة غير مدفوعة، سالبة للمبالغ المدفوعة مقدما)، أو عربون (دفعة مقدمة لحجز مستقبلي). استخدم الأرقام الختامية من آخر تدقيق ليلي في النظام القديم.
spanish: Una fila por saldo. El tipo puede ser «Huésped alojado» (lo que debe el huésped; negativo si tiene saldo a favor y 0 si está saldado), «Cuenta de empresa» (factura pendiente; negativo si se pagó por adelantado) o «Anticipo de reserva» (anticipo recibido para una reserva futura). Use las cifras del último cierre nocturno del sistema anterior.
portuguese: Uma linha por saldo. O tipo é Hospedado (o que o hóspede deve; negativo se estiver em crédito, 0 se liquidado), Faturado/City Ledger (fatura de empresa em aberto; negativo para adiantamentos) ou Depósito (sinal para reserva futura). Use os números de fechamento do sistema anterior.
chinese: 每个余额一行。类型为在住（客人欠款；贷方为负，结清为 0）、应收账户（未付公司发票；预付款为负）或押金（未来预订已付的预付款）。请使用旧系统最后一次夜审的期末数据。

key: One row per room: room number, room type (code or name), floor and notes. Set up the room types first. Rooms that already exist are updated, never duplicated.
english: One row per room: room number, room type (code or name), floor and notes. Set up the room types first. Rooms that already exist are updated, never duplicated.
arabic: صف لكل غرفة: رقم الغرفة، نوع الغرفة (الرمز أو الاسم)، الطابق والملاحظات. أنشئ أنواع الغرف أولًا. الغرف الموجودة تُحدَّث ولا تتكرر.
spanish: Una fila por habitación: número, tipo de habitación (código o nombre), piso y notas. Configure primero los tipos de habitación. Las habitaciones que ya existen se actualizan, nunca se duplican.
portuguese: Uma linha por quarto: número, tipo de quarto (código ou nome), andar e observações. Cadastre os tipos de quarto primeiro. Quartos que já existem são atualizados, nunca duplicados.
chinese: 每行一间客房：房号、房型（代码或名称）、楼层与备注。请先设置房型。已存在的客房会被更新，不会重复创建。

key: One ticket above this is refused - settle it at the outlet. 0 means no limit.
english: One ticket above this is refused - settle it at the outlet. 0 means no limit.
arabic: تُرفض أي تذكرة تتجاوز هذا المبلغ، سوّها في المنفذ. 0 يعني بلا حد.
spanish: Se rechaza una cuenta superior a este importe; debe liquidarse en el punto de venta. 0 = sin límite.
portuguese: Uma comanda acima deste valor é recusada - liquide diretamente no ponto de venda. 0 significa sem limite.
chinese: 超过该金额的单据将被拒绝 - 请在营业点结清。0 表示不限额。

key: One unit only. Recipes and purchases both use it - buy and cook in the same unit (e.g. define in g if you cook in g).
english: One unit only. Recipes and purchases both use it - buy and cook in the same unit (e.g. define in g if you cook in g).
arabic: وحدة واحدة فقط. تستخدمها الوصفات والمشتريات معا، فاشترِ واطبخ بالوحدة نفسها (مثلا عرّفها بالغرام إن كنت تطبخ بالغرام).
spanish: Una sola unidad para recetas y compras. Compre y cocine en la misma unidad; por ejemplo, defina gramos si cocina en gramos.
portuguese: Apenas uma unidade. Receitas e compras usam - compre e cozinhe na mesma unidade (por exemplo, defina em g se você cozinha em g).
chinese: 仅支持单一单位。配方与采购共用此单位 - 采购与制作使用同一单位（例如按克制作即按克定义）。

key: Online booking isn't available right now
english: Online booking isn't available right now
arabic: الحجز عبر الإنترنت غير متاح حاليًا
spanish: La reserva en línea no está disponible ahora
portuguese: A reserva online não está disponível agora

key: Online bookings on these dates pay the whole amount, not the usual advance
english: Online bookings on these dates pay the whole amount, not the usual advance
arabic: الحجوزات عبر الإنترنت في هذه التواريخ تدفع المبلغ كاملا، لا الدفعة المقدمة المعتادة
spanish: Las reservas en línea para estas fechas pagan el importe total en lugar del anticipo habitual
portuguese: As reservas online nestas datas pagam o valor total, não o adiantamento habitual
chinese: 这些日期的线上预订需付全款，而非通常的预付款

spanish: Enlace de registro en línea sin enviar

arabic: أُرسل التسجيل عبر الإنترنت، لم يُملأ
spanish: Enlace de registro en línea enviado, formulario sin completar
chinese: 在线入住已发送，未填写

key: Online collection uses the payment gateway set under Settings → Payments, where your country offers one (India: Razorpay or Cashfree). Until a gateway is connected, the advance is recorded as due and settled at the desk.
english: Online collection uses the payment gateway set under Settings → Payments, where your country offers one (India: Razorpay or Cashfree). Until a gateway is connected, the advance is recorded as due and settled at the desk.
arabic: يستخدم التحصيل عبر الإنترنت بوابة الدفع المحددة ضمن الإعدادات ← المدفوعات، حيث تتوفر في بلدك (الهند: Razorpay أو Cashfree). إلى أن تُربط بوابة، تُسجل الدفعة المقدمة كمستحقة وتُسوى في الاستقبال.
spanish: El cobro en línea utiliza la pasarela configurada en Configuración → Pagos, si hay una disponible para su país (India: Razorpay o Cashfree). Hasta conectarla, el anticipo queda pendiente y se cobra en recepción.
portuguese: A cobrança online usa o gateway de pagamento definido em Configurações → Pagamentos, onde seu país oferece um (Índia: Razorpay ou Cashfree). Até que um gateway seja conectado, o adiantamento é registrado como devido e liquidado no balcão.
chinese: 在线收款使用设置 → 支付中配置的网关（如所在国家支持，印度：Razorpay 或 Cashfree）。在连接网关前，预付款记为应收并在前台结清。

key: Online payment links are not available for this country yet. Take payments at the desk.
english: Online payment links are not available for this country yet. Take payments at the desk.
arabic: روابط الدفع عبر الإنترنت غير متاحة لهذا البلد بعد. حصّل الدفعات في الاستقبال.
spanish: Los enlaces de pago en línea aún no están disponibles para este país. Registre los cobros en recepción.
portuguese: Os links de pagamento online ainda não estão disponíveis para este país. Receba pagamentos na mesa.

key: Switch between the front and back camera
english: Switch between the front and back camera
spanish: Cambiar entre la cámara frontal y trasera
portuguese: Alternar entre a câmera frontal e traseira

key: Switch it on, save, and come back here.
english: Switch it on, save, and come back here.
arabic: فعّله واحفظ ثم عد إلى هنا.
spanish: Actívelo, guarde los cambios y vuelva aquí.
chinese: 开启并保存后返回此处。

key: Switch off single tools for AI clients at this property. Staff can still do the same thing in Kamra.
english: Switch off single tools for AI clients at this property. Staff can still do the same thing in Kamra.
arabic: أوقف أدوات محددة لعملاء الذكاء الاصطناعي في هذا العقار. يظل بإمكان الموظفين تنفيذ الإجراء نفسه في Kamra.
spanish: Desactive herramientas concretas para los clientes de IA en este alojamiento. El personal puede seguir haciendo lo mismo en Kamra.
portuguese: Desative ferramentas únicas para clientes de IA nesta propriedade. A equipe ainda pode fazer a mesma coisa em Kamra.
chinese: 在本酒店关闭 AI 客户端的单个工具。员工仍可在 Kamra 中执行相同操作。

key: Switch off the parts of Kamra this property doesn't run.
english: Switch off the parts of Kamra this property doesn't run.
arabic: أوقف أجزاء Kamra التي لا يستخدمها هذا العقار.
spanish: Desactive las funciones de Kamra que este alojamiento no utiliza.
portuguese: Desligue as partes de Kamra que esta propriedade não executa.
chinese: 关闭本酒店不使用的 Kamra 功能。

key: Switch off what this property doesn't run. Its apps leave the launcher, search and the AI agent's tools for everyone. Data is kept and comes back when you switch it on.
english: Switch off what this property doesn't run. Its apps leave the launcher, search and the AI agent's tools for everyone. Data is kept and comes back when you switch it on.
arabic: أوقف ما لا يستخدمه هذا العقار. تختفي تطبيقاته من المشغّل والبحث وأدوات وكيل الذكاء الاصطناعي للجميع. تُحفظ البيانات وتعود عند تفعيله.
spanish: Desactive los módulos que este alojamiento no utiliza. Dejarán de aparecer en el lanzador de aplicaciones, en las búsquedas y entre las herramientas disponibles para el agente de IA. Los datos se conservan y vuelven a aparecer cuando los active.
portuguese: Desligue o que esta propriedade não executa. Seus apps deixam o launcher, a busca e as ferramentas do agente de IA para todos. Os dados são mantidos e voltam quando você o liga.
chinese: 关闭本酒店不使用的功能。相关应用将从启动器、搜索与 AI 智能体工具中移除；数据保留，重新开启后恢复。

key: Switch on what you need. You can change this any time in Settings.
english: Switch on what you need. You can change this any time in Settings.
arabic: فعّل ما تحتاجه. يمكنك تغيير ذلك في أي وقت من الإعدادات.
spanish: Active los módulos que necesite. Puede cambiarlos en cualquier momento en Configuración.
portuguese: Ligue o que você precisa. Você pode alterar isso a qualquer momento em Configurações.
chinese: 开启你需要的功能，可随时在设置中更改。

key: Table ordering and in-room dining codes for {property}. Drawn on this device - no outside QR service.
english: Table ordering and in-room dining codes for {property}. Drawn on this device - no outside QR service.
arabic: رموز الطلب من الطاولات وطلب الطعام داخل الغرف لـ {property}. تُنشأ على هذا الجهاز - دون أي خدمة QR خارجية.
spanish: Códigos para pedidos desde mesas y habitaciones de {property}. Se generan en este dispositivo sin usar un servicio externo de códigos QR.
portuguese: Códigos de pedido de mesa e jantar no quarto para {property}. Desenhado neste dispositivo - nenhum serviço QR externo.
chinese: {property} 的桌台点单与客房送餐码。在本设备生成 - 无需外部二维码服务。

key: Take a payment or an authorisation, or ask the guest to settle part of the bill.
english: Take a payment or an authorisation, or ask the guest to settle part of the bill.
portuguese: Receba um pagamento ou autorização, ou solicite ao hóspede que acerte parte da fatura.
chinese: 收款或预授权，或请客人结清部分账单。

key: Take a percentage off stays of N nights or more.
english: Take a percentage off stays of N nights or more.
arabic: اخصم نسبة مئوية من الإقامات التي تبلغ N ليلة أو أكثر.
spanish: Descuenta un porcentaje a las estancias de N noches o más.
portuguese: Desconte uma porcentagem das estadias de N noites ou mais.
chinese: 对 N 晚及以上的住店给予折扣。

key: Take a picture of this guest's ID
english: Take a picture of this guest's ID
spanish: Toma una foto de la identificación de este huésped
portuguese: Tire uma foto do documento deste hóspede

key: Take the deposit (or waive it with a reason) to continue.
english: Take the deposit (or waive it with a reason) to continue.
arabic: استلم التأمين (أو أعفِ منه مع ذكر السبب) للمتابعة.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía o indique un motivo para exonerarlo y continuar.
portuguese: Aceite o depósito (ou renuncie com um motivo) para continuar.
chinese: 收取押金（或填写原因减免）后继续。

key: Take the security deposit (or waive it with a reason) and any advance the booking still owes.
english: Take the security deposit (or waive it with a reason) and any advance the booking still owes.
arabic: خذ مبلغ التأمين (أو اعف منه مع ذكر السبب) وأي دفعة مقدمة لا يزال الحجز مدينا بها.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía, o indique un motivo para exonerarlo, y el anticipo pendiente de la reserva.
portuguese: Pegue o depósito caução (ou renuncie com um motivo) e qualquer adiantamento que a reserva ainda deva.
chinese: 收取押金（或填写原因减免）以及预订仍欠的预付款。

key: Take the security deposit or waive it with a reason to continue.
english: Take the security deposit or waive it with a reason to continue.
arabic: خذ مبلغ التأمين أو اعف منه مع ذكر السبب للمتابعة.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía o indique un motivo para exonerarlo y continuar.
portuguese: Aceite o depósito caução ou renuncie a ele com um motivo para continuar.
chinese: 收取押金或填写原因减免后继续。

key: Taking or giving back money needs an open till, and your role can't open one. Ask {v0} to settle the bill.
english: Taking or giving back money needs an open till, and your role can't open one. Ask {v0} to settle the bill.
arabic: تحصيل الأموال أو ردها يتطلب صندوقًا مفتوحًا، ودورك لا يسمح بفتحه. اطلب من {v0} تسوية الفاتورة.
spanish: Para cobrar o devolver dinero se necesita una caja abierta y su rol no permite abrirla. Solicite a {v0} que liquide la cuenta.
portuguese: Movimentações financeiras exigem caixa aberto. Solicite a {v0} para liquidar a fatura.
chinese: 收款或退款需开启钱箱，而你的角色无法开启。请让 {v0} 结清账单。

key: Tap a panel to show or hide it. Use the arrows to change the order.
english: Tap a panel to show or hide it. Use the arrows to change the order.
arabic: اضغط على اللوحة لإظهارها أو إخفائها. استخدم الأسهم لتغيير الترتيب.
spanish: Toque un panel para mostrarlo u ocultarlo. Utilice las flechas para cambiar el orden.
portuguese: Toque em um painel para mostrá-lo ou ocultá-lo. Use as setas para alterar a ordem.
chinese: 点击面板显示或隐藏，用箭头调整顺序。

key: Tap a room to change its status, see who is in it, who stayed and who cleaned it.
english: Tap a room to change its status, see who is in it, who stayed and who cleaned it.
arabic: اضغط على غرفة لتغيير حالتها ومعرفة من فيها ومن أقام فيها ومن نظّفها.
spanish: Toque una habitación para cambiar su estado, ver quién está en ella, quién se quedó y quién la limpió.
portuguese: Toque em um cômodo para alterar seu status, ver quem está nele, quem ficou e quem o limpou.
chinese: 点击客房可更改状态，查看在住客人、历史住客与清洁人。

key: Tap a task and I'll ask you one thing at a time. Or just type what you need.
english: Tap a task and I'll ask you one thing at a time. Or just type what you need.
chinese: 点击任务，我会逐项询问。也可直接输入你的需求。

key: Tap an occupied room to post minibar or laundry.
english: Tap an occupied room to post minibar or laundry.
arabic: انقر غرفة مشغولة لترحيل ميني بار أو غسيل.
spanish: Toque una habitación ocupada para cargar los consumos del minibar o la lavandería al folio.
portuguese: Toque em um cômodo ocupado para colocar frigobar ou lavanderia.
chinese: 点击已入住房客可入账迷你吧或洗衣。

spanish: Toque los artículos del menú para agregarlos.
portuguese: Toque nos itens de menu para adicionar.

key: Targets vs performance, and where the business comes from.
english: Targets vs performance, and where the business comes from.
spanish: Metas, resultados y origen del negocio.
portuguese: Metas versus desempenho e de onde vem o negócio.
chinese: 目标与实际的对比，以及业务来源。

key: Task deadlines, room turnover and laundry pricing.
english: Task deadlines, room turnover and laundry pricing.
arabic: مواعيد المهام وتجهيز الغرف وأسعار الغسيل.
spanish: Plazos de tareas, preparación de habitaciones y tarifas de lavandería.
portuguese: Prazos de tarefas, rotatividade de quartos e preços de lavanderia.
chinese: 任务截止时间、客房周转与洗衣定价。

spanish: Aplicar impuesto a la tasa de alojamiento

key: Tax ID and guest ID checks through Kamra Connect.
english: Tax ID and guest ID checks through Kamra Connect.
arabic: التحقق من الرقم الضريبي وهوية الضيف عبر Kamra Connect.
spanish: Verificación fiscal y de documentos de huéspedes mediante Kamra Connect.
portuguese: Verificações de identificação fiscal e de hóspede por meio do Kamra Connect.
chinese: 通过 Kamra Connect 进行税号与客人证件核验。

key: Tax labels, ID types, payment methods and the guest phone code follow it.
english: Tax labels, ID types, payment methods and the guest phone code follow it.
arabic: تتبعها مسميات الضرائب وأنواع الهوية وطرق الدفع ورمز هاتف الضيف.
spanish: Determina las etiquetas fiscales, documentos de identidad, medios de pago y prefijo telefónico de los huéspedes.
portuguese: Seguem-se etiquetas fiscais, tipos de identificação, métodos de pagamento e o código de telefone do hóspede.
chinese: 税率标签、证件类型、支付方式与客人电话区号随之确定。

key: Tax on the room rate. Outlet and service rates come from the country pack.
english: Tax on the room rate. Outlet and service rates come from the country pack.
arabic: الضريبة على سعر الغرفة. نسب المنافذ والخدمات تأتي من حزمة الدولة.
spanish: Impuesto sobre la tarifa de habitación. Los impuestos de puntos de venta y servicios se obtienen de la configuración del país.
portuguese: Imposto sobre a tarifa do quarto. As tarifas de saída e serviço vêm do pacote do país.
chinese: 客房税按房价计。营业点与服务税率来自国家包。

arabic: الضريبة المدفوعة عند شراء هذا الصنف.
spanish: Impuesto pagado al comprar este ingrediente.
chinese: 采购此物品时支付的税。

key: Tell me what cancelling the booking for {q} would cost. Don't cancel until I say yes.
english: Tell me what cancelling the booking for {q} would cost. Don't cancel until I say yes.
chinese: 请告知取消 {q} 的预订需要多少费用。我确认前不要取消。

key: Tell the guest the Wi-Fi, breakfast and check-out times. Print it or send it on WhatsApp.
english: Tell the guest the Wi-Fi, breakfast and check-out times. Print it or send it on WhatsApp.
arabic: أخبر الضيف بالواي فاي ومواعيد الإفطار وتسجيل المغادرة. اطبعها أو أرسلها عبر واتساب.
spanish: Informe al huésped los datos del wifi y los horarios de desayuno y salida. Imprima la información o envíela por WhatsApp.
portuguese: Informe ao hóspede os horários de Wi-Fi, café da manhã e check-out. Imprima ou envie no WhatsApp.
chinese: 告知客人 Wi-Fi、早餐与退房时间，可打印或通过 WhatsApp 发送。

spanish: Código de idioma de las plantillas
Plantilla: aviso de cargo a la habitación
portuguese: Modelo: alerta de cobrança no quarto

spanish: Plantilla: enlace de registro de llegada

arabic: من عشر إلى خمس عشرة دقيقة

key: Test page sent. It prints on the kitchen screen set to print for {printer}.
english: Test page sent. It prints on the kitchen screen set to print for {printer}.
arabic: أُرسلت صفحة الاختبار. ستُطبع من شاشة المطبخ المعيّنة للطباعة إلى {printer}.
spanish: Página de prueba enviada. Se imprimirá desde la pantalla de cocina configurada para la impresora {printer}.
portuguese: Página de teste enviada. Ele é impresso na tela da cozinha configurada para imprimir para {printer}.
chinese: 测试页已发送，将在设置为 {printer} 打印的厨房屏上打印。

key: Thank the guest, hand over any deposit refund, and wish them a safe journey.
english: Thank the guest, hand over any deposit refund, and wish them a safe journey.
arabic: اشكر الضيف، وسلّمه أي مبلغ تأمين مسترد، وتمنَّ له رحلة آمنة.
spanish: Agradezca la visita al huésped, entregue el reembolso del depósito que corresponda y deséele buen viaje.
portuguese: Agradeça ao hóspede, entregue o reembolso do depósito e deseje-lhe uma boa viagem.
chinese: 感谢客人，退还应退押金，并祝旅途平安。

key: Thank you for staying with us, safe travels, and we hope to welcome you again.
english: Thank you for staying with us, safe travels, and we hope to welcome you again.
arabic: شكراً لإقامتك معنا، نتمنى لك رحلة آمنة ونأمل أن نستقبلك مجدداً.
spanish: Gracias por alojarse con nosotros. Le deseamos buen viaje y esperamos recibirle nuevamente.
portuguese: Obrigado por ficar conosco, boa viagem e esperamos recebê-lo novamente.
chinese: 感谢入住，祝旅途平安，期待再次欢迎你。

key: Thanks - our team will reach out about {name}.
english: Thanks - our team will reach out about {name}.
spanish: Gracias. Nuestro equipo se comunicará con usted sobre {name}.
portuguese: Obrigado. Nossa equipe entrará em contato sobre {name}.
chinese: 谢谢 - 我们的团队将就 {name} 与你联系。

key: That didn't go through. Please try again.
english: That didn't go through. Please try again.
arabic: لم تكتمل العملية. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.
spanish: La operación no se completó. Vuelva a intentarlo.
portuguese: Isso não aconteceu. Por favor, tente novamente.

key: That record wasn't found - it may have been removed.
english: That record wasn't found - it may have been removed.
arabic: لم يُعثر على هذا السجل، ربما تم حذفه.
spanish: No se encontró ese registro; es posible que se haya eliminado.
portuguese: Esse registro não foi encontrado - pode ter sido removido.
chinese: 未找到该记录 - 可能已被删除。

key: That room is another type. Use Upgrade or change type, so the price is shown first.
english: That room is another type. Use Upgrade or change type, so the price is shown first.
arabic: هذه الغرفة من نوع آخر. استخدم الترقية أو تغيير النوع ليظهر السعر أولًا.
spanish: Esa habitación es de otro tipo. Utilice Mejora de categoría o Cambiar tipo para ver primero el precio.
portuguese: Esse quarto é de outro tipo. Use Upgrade ou altere o tipo, para que o preço seja mostrado primeiro.
chinese: 该客房属于其他房型。请使用「升级」或「更换房型」，以便先显示价格。

key: That signature image is too large.
english: That signature image is too large.
spanish: La imagen de firma es demasiado grande.
portuguese: Essa imagem de assinatura é muito grande.

key: The 03:00 audit held the date. Clear the blockers and run End of Day, then print the pack.
english: The 03:00 audit held the date. Clear the blockers and run End of Day, then print the pack.
arabic: تدقيق الساعة 03:00 أوقف التاريخ. أزل العوائق وشغّل إقفال اليوم ثم اطبع الحزمة.
spanish: La auditoría de las 03:00 dejó la fecha en espera. Resuelva los bloqueos, ejecute el cierre del día e imprima el paquete.
portuguese: A auditoria das 03:00 manteve a data. Limpe os bloqueadores e execute o Fim do Dia, depois imprima o pacote.
chinese: 03:00 的夜审保留了日期。请处理阻断项后运行日结并打印审计包。

key: The agent couldn't finish - check the AI key in Settings.
english: The agent couldn't finish - check the AI key in Settings.
arabic: تعذّر على الوكيل الإكمال. تحقق من مفتاح الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإعدادات.
spanish: El agente no pudo completar la solicitud. Revise la clave de IA en Configuración.
portuguese: O agente não conseguiu terminar. Verifique a chave AI em Configurações.
chinese: 助手未能完成 - 请检查设置中的 AI 密钥。

key: The audit continues and the no-show policy applies to whoever is still listed.
english: The audit continues and the no-show policy applies to whoever is still listed.
arabic: يستمر التدقيق وتُطبق سياسة عدم الحضور على من لا يزال مدرجًا.
spanish: La auditoría continúa y la política de no presentación se aplica a las llegadas que sigan pendientes.
portuguese: A auditoria continua e a política de não comparecimento se aplica a quem ainda estiver listado.
chinese: 夜审继续，未到店政策适用于仍在名单上的客人。

key: The audit posts as it stands.
english: The audit posts as it stands.
spanish: La auditoría registra los datos actuales.
portuguese: Os postos de auditoria tal como estão.

key: The balance stays on the departed folio.
english: The balance stays on the departed folio.
arabic: يبقى الرصيد على فاتورة الضيف المغادر.
spanish: El saldo permanece en el folio del huésped que ya salió.
portuguese: O saldo permanece na folha que partiu.
chinese: 余额保留在已离店客账上。

key: The bill against what's already been received.
english: The bill against what's already been received.
spanish: La cuenta, considerando los pagos ya recibidos.
portuguese: O total da fatura confrontado com os valores já recebidos.
chinese: 账单与已收款项的对比。

key: The bill stays open into the next business date. Its sale is dated tomorrow, not today.
english: The bill stays open into the next business date. Its sale is dated tomorrow, not today.
arabic: تبقى الفاتورة مفتوحة حتى تاريخ العمل التالي. تُسجل مبيعاتها بتاريخ الغد لا اليوم.
spanish: La cuenta sigue abierta para la siguiente fecha operativa. La venta se registrará mañana.
portuguese: A fatura permanece aberta até a próxima data contábil. Sua venda está datada de amanhã, não de hoje.
chinese: 账单将保持未结至下一营业日，其销售记为明天而非今天。

key: The bills stay where they are posted.
english: The bills stay where they are posted.
spanish: Las cuentas permanecen en los folios donde se registraron.
portuguese: As faturas permanecem nos extratos onde foram lançadas.
chinese: 账单保持在各自入账处。

key: The bills this payment cleared are owed again, and any credit it left on the account is taken back.
english: The bills this payment cleared are owed again, and any credit it left on the account is taken back.
chinese: 该笔收款结清的账单将重新显示为欠款，账户上的贷方余额也会被收回。

key: The booking ended without a stay - nothing is owed.
english: The booking ended without a stay - nothing is owed.
arabic: انتهى الحجز دون إقامة، ولا يوجد مبلغ مستحق.
spanish: La reserva terminó sin estancia y no hay saldo pendiente.
portuguese: A reserva terminou sem estadia - nada é devido.
chinese: 预订未产生住店即结束 - 无欠款。

key: The browser could not open the print view.
english: The browser could not open the print view.
arabic: تعذّر على المتصفح فتح عرض الطباعة.
spanish: El navegador no pudo abrir la vista de impresión.
portuguese: O navegador não conseguiu abrir a visualização de impressão.
chinese: 浏览器无法打开打印视图。

key: The business date is ahead of the server date. The audit for it can run once that day has started.
english: The business date is ahead of the server date. The audit for it can run once that day has started.
arabic: تاريخ العمل يسبق تاريخ الخادم. يمكن تشغيل التدقيق له عندما يبدأ ذلك اليوم.
spanish: La fecha operativa es posterior a la fecha del servidor. La auditoría puede ejecutarse cuando comience esa fecha.
portuguese: A data operacional está à frente da data do servidor. O fechamento pode ser executado assim que o dia começar.
chinese: 营业日已超过服务器日期。该日到来后夜审方可运行。

key: The cashier has gone home: a manager counts the drawer with the envelope and closes it.
english: The cashier has gone home: a manager counts the drawer with the envelope and closes it.
arabic: غادر أمين الصندوق: يعدّ المدير الدرج مع الظرف ويغلقه.
spanish: Si el cajero ya se retiró, un gerente debe contar el efectivo junto con el sobre y cerrar la sesión.
portuguese: O caixa foi para casa: um gerente conta a gaveta com o envelope e fecha-a.
chinese: 收银员已下班：由经理按信封清点抽屉并关闭。

key: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a room block on it, so it genuinely leaves the sellable inventory rather than living on a note.
english: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a room block on it, so it genuinely leaves the sellable inventory rather than living on a note.
arabic: غرفة تبديل الملابس لموكب الزفاف. تخصيص غرفة يضع عليها حجبًا، فتخرج فعليًا من المخزون القابل للبيع بدلًا من الاكتفاء بملاحظة.
spanish: Vestidor para los participantes de la boda. Al asignar una habitación se bloquea su venta y se retira del inventario disponible.
portuguese: O camarim para o grupo do casamento. Ao atribuir, um bloqueio de quarto é criado, saindo do inventário disponível para venda.
chinese: 婚礼方的更衣室。分配后会形成客房预留，真正从可售库存中扣除，而非仅作备注。

key: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a space block on it, so it actually leaves sellable inventory rather than living as a note.
english: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a space block on it, so it actually leaves sellable inventory rather than living as a note.
portuguese: O camarim para o grupo do casamento. Ao atribuir, o espaço é bloqueado e sai do inventário disponível, em vez de ser apenas uma anotação.
chinese: 婚礼方的更衣室。分配后会形成场地预留，真正从可售库存中扣除，而非仅作备注。

key: The chosen dishes, exploded through their recipes at
english: The chosen dishes, exploded through their recipes at
arabic: الأطباق المختارة مفصّلة حسب وصفاتها عند

portuguese: Os pratos escolhidos, explodiram em suas receitas em
chinese: 所选菜品按其配方展开，成本为

key: The company's billing rules decide what it pays, on one group bill.
english: The company's billing rules decide what it pays, on one group bill.
arabic: تحدد قواعد فوترة الشركة ما تدفعه، على فاتورة مجموعة واحدة.
spanish: Las reglas de facturación de la empresa deciden qué paga, en una sola cuenta de grupo.
portuguese: As regras de faturamento da empresa definem a cobertura na fatura única do grupo.
chinese: 公司账单规则决定其支付内容，合并为一张团队账单。

key: The core of Kamra: taking bookings, checking guests in and out, billing. Always on.
english: The core of Kamra: taking bookings, checking guests in and out, billing. Always on.
arabic: أساس Kamra: استقبال الحجوزات، وتسجيل وصول الضيوف ومغادرتهم، والفوترة. مفعّل دائمًا.
spanish: Funciones principales de Kamra: reservas, registro de llegadas y salidas y facturación. Siempre activas.
portuguese: O núcleo do Kamra: receber reservas, fazer check-in e check-out de hóspedes, cobrança. Sempre ligado.
chinese: Kamra 核心功能：接预订、办理入住退房、计费。始终开启。

key: the Data Protection Board of India
english: the Data Protection Board of India
spanish: la Junta de Protección de Datos de la India
portuguese: o Conselho de Proteção de Dados da Índia

key: The deposit and damages were settled at the first close-out. Closing again records the covers only - bill anything further as a line on the function.
english: The deposit and damages were settled at the first close-out. Closing again records the covers only - bill anything further as a line on the function.
arabic: سُوّي التأمين والأضرار في الإغلاق الأول. الإغلاق مجددًا يسجّل عدد الأشخاص فقط، وأي رسوم إضافية تُضاف كبند على المناسبة.
spanish: El depósito y los daños se liquidaron en el primer cierre. Este cierre solo registra los comensales; agregue cualquier cargo adicional como una línea del evento.
portuguese: O depósito e os danos foram liquidados no primeiro encerramento. Fechar novamente registra apenas as capas - fature qualquer coisa adicional como uma linha na função.
chinese: 押金与损坏已在首次结束时结清。再次结束仅记录用餐人数 - 其他费用请作为活动行项开票。

key: The discount spreads pro-rata across the lines, so each keeps its own
english: The discount spreads pro-rata across the lines, so each keeps its own
arabic: يُوزَّع الخصم نسبيًا على البنود، ويحتفظ كل بند بنسبة
spanish: El descuento se distribuye proporcionalmente entre las líneas, conservando cada una su tasa de
portuguese: O desconto é distribuído proporcionalmente pelas linhas, de modo que cada uma mantém o seu
chinese: 折扣按比例分摊到各行，各行保留自身

key: The duplicate's stays, bills and tickets move to
english: The duplicate's stays, bills and tickets move to
arabic: تنتقل إقامات النسخة المكررة وفواتيرها وتذاكرها إلى
spanish: Las estancias, cuentas y solicitudes del duplicado se transfieren a
portuguese: As estadias, faturas e chamados do registro duplicado passam para
chinese: 重复项的历史住店、账单与工单将移至

key: The final reports are printed after room and tax are posted.
english: The final reports are printed after room and tax are posted.
arabic: تُطبع التقارير النهائية بعد ترحيل الغرفة والضريبة.
spanish: Los informes finales se imprimen después de registrar los cargos de habitación e impuestos.
portuguese: Os relatórios finais são impressos após o lançamento das diárias e impostos.
chinese: 最终报表在房费与税入账后打印。

key: The floors of the property, in the order the room boards and filters show them.
english: The floors of the property, in the order the room boards and filters show them.
arabic: طوابق العقار بالترتيب الذي تعرضه لوحات الغرف والمرشحات.
spanish: Los pisos del alojamiento, en el orden en que los muestran los tableros de habitaciones y los filtros.
portuguese: Os andares da propriedade, na ordem em que os painéis de quartos e os filtros os mostram.
chinese: 酒店楼层，按房态看板与筛选器的显示顺序排列。

key: The folio only has {amt} in credit - settle the bill first, or let the deposit cover it.
english: The folio only has {amt} in credit - settle the bill first, or let the deposit cover it.
arabic: رصيد الفاتورة الدائن {amt} فقط - سدّد الفاتورة أولًا، أو دع التأمين يغطيها.
spanish: El folio solo tiene {amt} de saldo a favor. Liquide la cuenta primero o use el depósito de garantía para cubrirla.
portuguese: O extrato possui apenas {amt} de crédito - liquide a fatura primeiro ou utilize o adiantamento.
chinese: 客账仅有 {amt} 贷方 - 请先结清账单，或让押金抵扣。

key: The folio was invoiced before every night was posted. Open it and cancel the invoice, then check out.
english: The folio was invoiced before every night was posted. Open it and cancel the invoice, then check out.
arabic: أُصدرت الفاتورة الضريبية قبل ترحيل كل الليالي. افتح الفاتورة وألغِ الفاتورة الضريبية، ثم سجّل المغادرة.
spanish: El folio se facturó antes de registrar todas las noches. Ábralo, cancele la factura y luego registre la salida.
portuguese: O extrato foi faturado antes de todas as noites serem lançadas. Abra-o, cancele a fatura e depois faça o check-out.
chinese: 客账在全部间夜入账前已开票。请打开客账取消发票后再退房。

key: The folios add up to more than the payment.
english: The folios add up to more than the payment.
arabic: مجموع الفواتير أكبر من مبلغ الدفعة.
spanish: La suma de los folios supera el importe del pago.
portuguese: Os fólios somam mais do que o pagamento.
chinese: 客账合计超过收款金额。

key: The front office and the room board disagree, for example a room occupied in one and vacant in the other.
english: The front office and the room board disagree, for example a room occupied in one and vacant in the other.
arabic: الاستقبال ولوحة الغرف غير متطابقين، مثل غرفة مشغولة في أحدهما وشاغرة في الآخر.
spanish: Recepción y el tablero de habitaciones muestran estados distintos; por ejemplo, una habitación aparece ocupada en uno y desocupada en el otro.
portuguese: A recepção e o mapa de quartos discordam, por exemplo um quarto ocupado em um e vago no outro.
chinese: 前厅与房态看板不一致，例如一方显示在住、另一方显示空置。

key: The full amount is paid online to confirm this booking.
english: The full amount is paid online to confirm this booking.
arabic: يُدفع المبلغ كاملًا عبر الإنترنت لتأكيد هذا الحجز.
spanish: Para confirmar la reserva, se paga el importe total en línea.
portuguese: O valor total é pago online para confirmar esta reserva.
chinese: 确认此预订需在线支付全款。

key: The group account {v0} pays as agreed.
english: The group account {v0} pays as agreed.
spanish: La cuenta del grupo {v0} paga según lo acordado.
portuguese: A conta do grupo {v0} paga conforme combinado.
chinese: 团队账户 {v0} 按约定支付。

key: The group bill starts when the first room charge or deposit is posted.
english: The group bill starts when the first room charge or deposit is posted.
portuguese: A fatura do grupo é gerada com o primeiro lançamento de diária ou adiantamento.
chinese: 首笔房费或押金入账时开立团队账单。

key: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guest. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
english: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guest. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
arabic: تتجاوز المجموعة السعة المحددة بـ {n} ضيف. يجب أن يؤكد العقار مشاركة الأسرّة والسعر.
spanish: El grupo supera la capacidad indicada por {n} persona. El alojamiento debe confirmar si es posible compartir camas y cuál sería el precio.
portuguese: O grupo excede a capacidade listada por {n} hóspede. A propriedade deverá confirmar o compartilhamento da cama e o preço.
chinese: 团队超出标称容量 {n} 位客人。酒店需确认拼床与价格。

key: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guests. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
english: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guests. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
arabic: تتجاوز المجموعة السعة المحددة بـ {n} ضيوف. يجب أن يؤكد العقار مشاركة الأسرّة والسعر.
spanish: El grupo supera la capacidad indicada por {n} personas. El alojamiento debe confirmar si es posible compartir camas y cuál sería el precio.
portuguese: O grupo excede a capacidade listada em {n} hóspedes. A propriedade deverá confirmar o compartilhamento da cama e o preço.
chinese: 团队超出标称容量 {n} 位客人。酒店需确认拼床与价格。

key: The guest already signed (online or earlier). Continue, or ask them to sign again below.
english: The guest already signed (online or earlier). Continue, or ask them to sign again below.
arabic: وقع الضيف مسبقا (عبر الإنترنت أو من قبل). تابع، أو اطلب منه التوقيع مجددا أدناه.
spanish: El huésped ya firmó (en línea o antes). Continúe o pídales que firmen nuevamente a continuación.
portuguese: O hóspede já assinou (online ou anterior). Continue ou peça que assinem novamente abaixo.
chinese: 客人已签名（线上或此前）。可继续，或在下方请其重新签名。

key: The guest checked in online{when}. Check what they sent against the guest at the desk.
english: The guest checked in online{when}. Check what they sent against the guest at the desk.
arabic: سجل الضيف وصوله عبر الإنترنت{when}. طابق ما أرسله مع الضيف عند المكتب.
spanish: El huésped completó el registro de entrada en línea{when}. Verifique en recepción que los datos enviados correspondan al huésped.
portuguese: O hóspede fez check-in online{when}. Verifique as informações enviadas com o hóspede na recepção.
chinese: 客人已在线入住{when}。请核对所提交内容与前台客人是否一致。

key: The guest folio is closed, so a charge can't be added here. Open the folio.
english: The guest folio is closed, so a charge can't be added here. Open the folio.
arabic: فاتورة الضيف مغلقة، لذا لا يمكن إضافة رسوم هنا. افتح الفاتورة.
spanish: El folio de huésped está cerrado, por lo que no se puede agregar un cargo aquí. Abre el folio.
portuguese: A conta do hóspede está fechada, portanto não é possível adicionar cobrança aqui. Abra o extrato.
chinese: 客人客账已关闭，无法在此添加费用。请打开客账。

key: The guest is already in house. Use Room move to change rooms.
english: The guest is already in house. Use Room move to change rooms.
arabic: الضيف مقيم بالفعل. استخدم نقل الغرفة لتغيير الغرفة.
spanish: El huésped ya está alojado. Utilice Cambio de habitación para trasladarlo.
portuguese: O hóspede já está hospedado. Use Troca de quarto para mudar de quarto.
chinese: 客人已在住。请使用「换房」更改客房。

key: The guest is in-house: the old room is marked Dirty for housekeeping.
english: The guest is in-house: the old room is marked Dirty for housekeeping.
arabic: النزيل مقيم: تُعلَّم الغرفة السابقة متسخة للتدبير المنزلي.
spanish: El huésped está alojado. La habitación anterior se marcará como sucia para que el personal de limpieza la atienda.
portuguese: O hóspede está hospedado: o quarto anterior foi marcado como Sujo para a governança.
chinese: 客人在住：原客房已标记为待清洁，供客房部处理。

key: The guest must know their ID is read by Kamra's verification partner
english: The guest must know their ID is read by Kamra's verification partner
arabic: يجب إعلام الضيف بأن شريك التحقق لدى Kamra سيقرأ هويته
spanish: El huésped debe saber que el socio de verificación de Kamra leerá su documento de identidad
portuguese: O hóspede deve saber que seu documento de identidade foi lido pelo parceiro de verificação da Kamra
chinese: 客人须知晓其证件由 Kamra 的验证合作方读取

key: The guest pays at the outlet. Outlets cannot post to this room.
english: The guest pays at the outlet. Outlets cannot post to this room.
arabic: يدفع الضيف في المنفذ. لا يمكن للمنافذ تحميل رسوم على هذه الغرفة.
spanish: El huésped paga en el punto de venta. Los puntos de venta no pueden cargar consumos a esta habitación.
portuguese: O hóspede paga no ponto de venda. Os pontos de venda não podem lançar neste quarto.
chinese: 客人需在营业点付款。营业点不可记入此客房。

key: The guest signed the printed card
english: The guest signed the printed card
spanish: El huésped firmó la ficha impresa
portuguese: O hóspede assinou a ficha impressa
chinese: 客人已在打印卡上签名

spanish: La cuenta del huésped está liquidada.
portuguese: A fatura do hóspede está liquidada.

key: The guided check-in follows these steps in order. Required steps cannot be skipped, and the guest cannot be checked in until they are done.
english: The guided check-in follows these steps in order. Required steps cannot be skipped, and the guest cannot be checked in until they are done.
arabic: يتبع تسجيل الوصول الموجه هذه الخطوات بالترتيب. لا يمكن تخطي الخطوات المطلوبة، ولا يمكن تسجيل وصول الضيف حتى تنجز.
spanish: El check-in guiado sigue estos pasos en orden. No se pueden omitir los pasos requeridos y no se puede registrar al huésped hasta que haya terminado.
portuguese: O check-in guiado segue estes passos em ordem. As etapas necessárias não podem ser ignoradas e o hóspede não poderá fazer check-in até que seja concluído.
chinese: 引导式入住按这些步骤依次进行。必填步骤不可跳过，完成前无法为该客人办理入住。

key: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in; the desk sees a warning to backfill.
english: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in; the desk sees a warning to backfill.
arabic: يتبع تسجيل الوصول الموجّه هذه الخطوات. الغرفة وحدها يجب إنجازها قبل تسجيل الوصول. يمكن إكمال الخطوات المطلوبة الأخرى بعد دخول النزيل؛ ويرى المكتب تنبيهاً لاستكمالها.
spanish: El check-in guiado sigue estos pasos. Solo debe completarse la Habitación antes del check-in. Los demás pasos obligatorios pueden completarse después de que el huésped ingrese; la recepción verá un aviso para completarlos.
portuguese: O check-in guiado segue estes passos. Apenas o quarto deve ser feito antes do check-in. Outras etapas obrigatórias podem ser concluídas após a entrada do hóspede; a mesa vê um aviso para preencher.
chinese: 引导式入住按这些步骤进行。入住前仅「客房」必填。其他必填步骤可在客人入住后完成，前台会看到补录提醒。

key: The hall's rack rental goes on as the first line - the number the conversation starts from.
english: The hall's rack rental goes on as the first line - the number the conversation starts from.
arabic: إيجار القاعة الأساسي يُضاف كأول بند - الرقم الذي تبدأ منه المحادثة.
spanish: La tarifa base de alquiler del salón se agrega como primera línea y sirve de punto de partida para la cotización.
portuguese: O aluguel do rack do salão continua como a primeira linha - o número a partir do qual a conversa começa.
chinese: 宴会厅门市租金作为第一行列示 - 即洽谈的起谈价。

spanish: La verificación de saldo alto está desactivada (umbral 0).
portuguese: A verificação de saldo alto está desativada (limite 0).
chinese: 高余额检查已关闭（阈值 0）。

key: The hold date has passed with {v0}% of the kept rooms used.
english: The hold date has passed with {v0}% of the kept rooms used.
portuguese: O prazo limite venceu com {v0}% dos quartos bloqueados utilizados.
chinese: 保留日期已过，保留客房已使用 {v0}%。

key: The hotel default is the standard layout again.
english: The hotel default is the standard layout again.
arabic: عاد الإعداد الافتراضي للفندق إلى التخطيط القياسي.
spanish: El diseño predeterminado del hotel vuelve a ser el estándar.
portuguese: O padrão do hotel é o layout padrão novamente.
chinese: 已恢复酒店默认的标准布局。

key: The hotel keeps a copy of your ID with its registration records.
english: The hotel keeps a copy of your ID with its registration records.
arabic: يحتفظ الفندق بنسخة من هويتك مع سجلات التسجيل.
spanish: El hotel conserva una copia de su documento de identidad en el registro de huéspedes.
portuguese: O hotel guarda uma cópia do seu documento de identificação com os registos de registo.
chinese: 酒店将其证件副本与登记记录一并保存。

key: The hotel's billing rules pick the folio, and food and drink take the hotel's food tax rate.
english: The hotel's billing rules pick the folio, and food and drink take the hotel's food tax rate.
arabic: قواعد الفوترة في الفندق تختار الفاتورة، والطعام والشراب يأخذان نسبة ضريبة الطعام في الفندق.
spanish: Las reglas de facturación determinan el folio al que se cargan los consumos. A los alimentos y bebidas se les aplica la tasa de impuesto configurada para ellos.
portuguese: As regras de cobrança do hotel escolhem o extrato, e alimentos e bebidas cobram a taxa de imposto alimentar do hotel.
chinese: 酒店的账单规则决定客账归属，餐饮按酒店餐饮税率计税。

key: The inspection task is due this long after the clean is done.
english: The inspection task is due this long after the clean is done.
arabic: موعد مهمة الفحص بعد هذه المدة من انتهاء التنظيف.
spanish: La inspección vence una vez transcurrido este tiempo desde que termina la limpieza.
portuguese: A tarefa de inspeção deve ser realizada muito depois de a limpeza ser concluída.
chinese: 查房任务在清洁完成后该时长到期。

key: The Kamra version this site is running
english: The Kamra version this site is running
arabic: إصدار Kamra الذي يعمل عليه هذا الموقع
spanish: La versión de Kamra que ejecuta este sitio
portuguese: A versão Kamra que este site está executando
chinese: 本站点运行的 Kamra 版本

key: The key stays on your server, stored masked. Usage is billed to your own provider account.
english: The key stays on your server, stored masked. Usage is billed to your own provider account.
arabic: يبقى المفتاح على خادمك محفوظًا بشكل مخفي. يُفوتر الاستخدام على حسابك لدى المزوّد.
spanish: La clave permanece oculta en su servidor. El consumo se factura a su cuenta del proveedor de IA.
portuguese: A chave permanece mascarada no seu servidor. O uso é faturado diretamente pelo seu provedor.
chinese: 密钥保存在你的服务器上并以掩码存储。用量由你自己的提供商账户计费。

key: The kitchen already has {n} item(s). They are voided, not deleted: the kitchen is told to stop, and a supervisor approves.
english: The kitchen already has {n} item(s). They are voided, not deleted: the kitchen is told to stop, and a supervisor approves.
arabic: لدى المطبخ {n} صنف بالفعل. تُبطل ولا تُحذف: يُبلَّغ المطبخ بالتوقف، ويوافق مشرف.
spanish: La cocina ya recibió {n} artículo(s). Se anulan, no se eliminan: se avisa a la cocina que deje de prepararlos y un supervisor debe aprobar la anulación.
portuguese: A cozinha já possui {n} item(s). Eles são anulados, não excluídos: a cozinha é instruída a parar e um supervisor aprova.
chinese: 厨房已有 {n} 个项目。将作废而非删除：通知厨房停止，并由主管审批。

key: The kitchen store cupboard - name, unit, category and cost. Stock movements live under Kitchen Inventory; recipes under Menu → Recipes.
english: The kitchen store cupboard - name, unit, category and cost. Stock movements live under Kitchen Inventory; recipes under Menu → Recipes.
arabic: مخزن المطبخ: الاسم والوحدة والفئة والتكلفة. حركات المخزون في مخزون المطبخ، والوصفات في القائمة → الوصفات.

portuguese: A cotação, o cronograma, a apólice e os blocos de assinatura.
