arabic: هذا يوقف التدقيق. عالجه أو أقرّ به مع ذكر السبب - يُسجّل اسمك والوقت في التدقيق.
spanish: Esto bloquea la auditoría. Resuélvalo o confirme la revisión indicando el motivo. Su nombre y la hora quedarán registrados en la auditoría.
portuguese: Isso bloqueia a auditoria. Resolva ou indique um motivo - seu nome e o horário ficam registrados na auditoria.
chinese: 此项会阻断夜审。请处理，或填写原因确认 - 你的姓名与时间会记录在审计中。

key: This booking has no company. Add the company to the booking first.
english: This booking has no company. Add the company to the booking first.
arabic: لا توجد شركة في هذا الحجز. أضف الشركة إلى الحجز أولًا.
spanish: Esta reserva no tiene empresa. Agréguela primero a la reserva.
portuguese: Esta reserva não tem companhia. Adicione a empresa à reserva primeiro.
chinese: 此预订无公司。请先为预订添加公司。

key: This booking has no guest profile.
english: This booking has no guest profile.
arabic: لا يوجد ملف ضيف لهذا الحجز.
spanish: Esta reserva no tiene perfil de huésped.
portuguese: Esta reserva não possui perfil de hóspede.

key: This booking is not part of a group.
english: This booking is not part of a group.
spanish: Esta reserva no forma parte de un grupo.
portuguese: Esta reserva não faz parte de um grupo.
chinese: 此预订不属于任何团队。

key: This browser cannot use a camera here. Upload a picture instead.
english: This browser cannot use a camera here. Upload a picture instead.
arabic: لا يمكن لهذا المتصفح استخدام الكاميرا هنا. ارفع صورة بدلًا من ذلك.
spanish: Este navegador no puede utilizar una cámara aquí. Sube una foto en su lugar.
portuguese: Este navegador não pode usar uma câmera aqui. Em vez disso, carregue uma foto.
chinese: 此浏览器无法使用摄像头。请改为上传图片。

key: This change re-prices the stay from {from} to {to}. Confirm the new price?
english: This change re-prices the stay from {from} to {to}. Confirm the new price?
arabic: هذا التغيير يعيد تسعير الإقامة من {from} إلى {to}. هل تؤكد السعر الجديد؟
spanish: Este cambio modifica el total de la estancia de {from} a {to}. ¿Confirma el nuevo precio?
portuguese: Esta alteração revaloriza a estadia de {from} para {to}. Confirmar o novo preço?
chinese: 此变更将住店价格由 {from} 调整为 {to}。确认新价格？

key: This check-in link isn't valid. Please contact the hotel.
english: This check-in link isn't valid. Please contact the hotel.
arabic: رابط تسجيل الوصول هذا غير صالح. يرجى التواصل مع الفندق.
spanish: Este enlace de registro de entrada ya no es válido. Ponte en contacto con el alojamiento.
portuguese: Este link de check-in não é válido. Por favor, entre em contato com o hotel.
chinese: 此入住链接无效，请联系酒店。

key: This checks out {name} only. Check out the others one at a time when they leave.
english: This checks out {name} only. Check out the others one at a time when they leave.
arabic: هذا يسجل مغادرة {name} فقط. سجّل مغادرة الآخرين واحداً تلو الآخر عند مغادرتهم.
spanish: Esto registra la salida únicamente de {name}. Registre la salida de los demás huéspedes por separado cuando se retiren.
portuguese: Isso realiza o check-out apenas de {name}. Faça o check-out dos demais um a um quando saírem.
chinese: 仅 {name} 办理退房。其他客人离店时逐个办理。

key: This closes the bag without billing. Tell us why - it's recorded on the order.
english: This closes the bag without billing. Tell us why - it's recorded on the order.
arabic: يغلق هذا الحقيبة دون فوترة. أخبرنا لماذا - يُسجَّل على الطلب.
spanish: Esto cierra la orden de lavandería sin facturar. Indique el motivo; quedará registrado en la orden.
portuguese: Isso fecha o saco sem faturar. Diga-nos o porquê - está registrado no pedido.
chinese: 将不计费直接结束该袋。请说明原因 - 会记录在订单上。

portuguese: Isto confirma que a sua reserva

key: This dish never touches inventory. That's a valid choice - most menus only ever cost their big movers.
english: This dish never touches inventory. That's a valid choice - most menus only ever cost their big movers.
arabic: هذا الطبق لا يؤثر في المخزون. هذا خيار صحيح، فمعظم القوائم تحسب تكلفة أصنافها الأكثر مبيعًا فقط.
spanish: Este plato no descuenta inventario. Es una opción válida; muchos menús solo calculan los costos de sus platos de mayor venta.
portuguese: Este prato nunca toca no inventário. Essa é uma escolha válida - a maioria dos menus custa apenas seus grandes impulsionadores.
chinese: 此菜品不占库存。这是合理选择 - 多数菜单只核算主要耗材的成本。

spanish: Este huésped está en la lista negra
portuguese: Este hóspede está na lista restrita (blacklist)

spanish: Esta es una factura generada por computadora.
portuguese: Esta é uma fatura gerada por computador.
chinese: 本发票由系统自动生成。

key: This is a computer-generated tax invoice under the GST Act.
english: This is a computer-generated tax invoice under the GST Act.
arabic: هذه فاتورة ضريبية مولّدة حاسوبياً بموجب قانون GST.
spanish: Esta factura fiscal se generó electrónicamente conforme a la ley del GST.
portuguese: Esta é uma fatura fiscal gerada por computador de acordo com a Lei GST.
chinese: 本税务发票依据 GST 法由系统自动生成。

key: This is a management P&L. It counts what Kamra records: guest and company bills, restaurant bills, banquets, supplier bills and petty cash. Payroll, depreciation, loans and anything paid outside Kamra are not in it. Your accountant keeps the statutory books from the Accounting Export.
english: This is a management P&L. It counts what Kamra records: guest and company bills, restaurant bills, banquets, supplier bills and petty cash. Payroll, depreciation, loans and anything paid outside Kamra are not in it. Your accountant keeps the statutory books from the Accounting Export.
arabic: هذا بيان أرباح وخسائر إداري. يحتسب ما يسجله Kamra: فواتير النزلاء والشركات وفواتير المطعم والحفلات وفواتير الموردين والمصروفات النثرية. لا يشمل الرواتب والإهلاك والقروض وأي مدفوعات خارج Kamra. يحتفظ محاسبك بالدفاتر النظامية من خلال التصدير المحاسبي.
spanish: Este es un estado de resultados de gestión. Cuenta lo que registra Kamra: facturas de huéspedes y empresas, cuentas del restaurante, banquetes, facturas de proveedores y caja chica. No incluye nómina, depreciación, préstamos ni nada pagado fuera de Kamra. Tu contador lleva los libros oficiales con la Exportación contable.
portuguese: DRE gerencial consolidado: faturas de hóspedes e empresas, restaurante, eventos, faturas de fornecedores e caixa pequeno. Folha de pagamento, depreciação e empréstimos externos são apurados na contabilidade via Exportação Contábil.
chinese: 这是管理损益表，仅统计 Kamra 记录的内容：客人与公司账单、餐厅账单、宴会、供应商账单与备用金。人工、折旧、借款及 Kamra 之外支付的项目不在其中。法定账目请由会计基于「会计导出」维护。

key: This is a quotation - no rooms are kept yet. Send it to the client; when they agree, confirm it.
english: This is a quotation - no rooms are kept yet. Send it to the client; when they agree, confirm it.
portuguese: Este é um orçamento - nenhum quarto foi bloqueado ainda. Envie ao cliente; após aprovação, confirme a reserva.
chinese: 这是报价单 - 尚未锁房。发给客户，确认后再转为预订。

key: This kitchen has no dishes on its menu yet.
english: This kitchen has no dishes on its menu yet.

key: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
english: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
arabic: هذه الوحدة متوقفة، لذا تطبيقاتها مخفية عن الجميع. تُحفظ الإعدادات لحين إعادة تفعيلها.
spanish: Este módulo está desactivado y sus aplicaciones están ocultas para todos. La configuración se conserva para cuando vuelva a activarlo.
portuguese: Este módulo está desativado, portanto seus aplicativos ficam ocultos para todos. As configurações são mantidas para quando você ligá-lo novamente.
chinese: 此模块已关闭，相关应用对所有人隐藏。设置会保留，重新开启后恢复。

key: This package has no dishes attached yet - add them to its courses under Menus & Services, and the customer can start choosing.
english: This package has no dishes attached yet - add them to its courses under Menus & Services, and the customer can start choosing.
arabic: لا توجد أطباق مرتبطة بهذه الباقة بعد. أضفها إلى مراحل التقديم في القوائم والخدمات ليبدأ العميل الاختيار.
spanish: Este paquete aún no tiene platos asociados. Agréguelos a sus tiempos en Menús y servicios para que el cliente pueda elegir.
portuguese: Este pacote ainda não possui pratos anexados - adicione-os aos seus pratos em Menus e Serviços e o cliente pode começar a escolher.
chinese: 此套餐尚未关联菜品 - 请在「菜单与服务」中按菜序添加，客户即可开始选择。

key: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
english: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
arabic: يرحّل هذا غرفة وضريبة الليلة لكل نزيل مقيم، ويطبّق سياسة عدم الحضور، ويحفظ حزمة التدقيق وينقل تاريخ العمل من {bd}. لا يمكن التراجع عنه.
spanish: Esto registra los cargos de habitación e impuestos de esta noche para cada huésped alojado, aplica la política de huéspedes no presentados, guarda el paquete de auditoría y avanza la fecha operativa desde {bd}. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
portuguese: Isso lança a diária e impostos desta noite para cada hóspede no hotel, aplica a política de no-show, salva o pacote de auditoria e avança a data de negócios de {bd}. Não pode ser desfeito.
chinese: 将为所有在住客人入账今晚房费与税、执行未到店政策、保存审计包并将营业日由 {bd} 推进。此操作不可撤销。

key: This property deletes ID scans at checkout and keeps only the last 4 digits. The profile keeps the type, dates and that the ID was verified. Ask for the ID again on a new stay.
english: This property deletes ID scans at checkout and keeps only the last 4 digits. The profile keeps the type, dates and that the ID was verified. Ask for the ID again on a new stay.
arabic: يحذف هذا العقار صور الهوية عند المغادرة ويحتفظ بآخر 4 أرقام فقط. يحتفظ الملف بالنوع والتواريخ وبأن الهوية جرى التحقق منها. اطلب الهوية مجددًا عند إقامة جديدة.
spanish: Este alojamiento elimina las imágenes de documentos de identidad al registrar la salida y conserva solo los últimos cuatro dígitos. El perfil guarda el tipo de documento, las fechas y que fue verificado. Solicite el documento nuevamente en la próxima estancia.
portuguese: Esta propriedade exclui digitalizações de documentos no check-out e mantém apenas os últimos 4 dígitos. O perfil mantém o tipo, datas e a confirmação de verificação. Solicite novamente o documento em uma nova estadia.
chinese: 本酒店在退房时删除证件扫描件，仅保留后 4 位。资料中保留证件类型、日期与已核验标记。新住店需重新出示证件。

key: This property only - switch hotel in the header to see another.
english: This property only - switch hotel in the header to see another.
arabic: هذا العقار فقط. بدّل الفندق من الترويسة لعرض غيره.
spanish: Solo este alojamiento. Cambie de hotel en el encabezado para consultar otro.
portuguese: Somente esta propriedade: troque de hotel no cabeçalho para ver outro.
chinese: 仅限本酒店 - 在页头切换酒店可查看其他。

key: This records the payment. It does not take cash from a till.
english: This records the payment. It does not take cash from a till.
arabic: هذا يسجل الدفعة فقط. ولا يأخذ نقدًا من أي صندوق.
spanish: Esto registra el pago. No saca efectivo de ninguna caja.
portuguese: Isto registra o pagamento. Não tira dinheiro de nenhum caixa.
chinese: 此处仅记录收款，不从钱箱支取现金。

key: This room is not cleaned yet. Pick a clean room, or ask housekeeping first.
english: This room is not cleaned yet. Pick a clean room, or ask housekeeping first.
arabic: هذه الغرفة لم تنظف بعد. اختر غرفة نظيفة، أو اسأل التدبير المنزلي أولا.
spanish: Esta habitación aún no se ha limpiado. Elija una habitación limpia o pregunte primero al servicio de limpieza.
portuguese: Este quarto ainda não foi limpo. Escolha um quarto limpo ou peça primeiro ao serviço de limpeza.
chinese: 此客房尚未清洁。请选择已清洁客房，或先联系客房部。

key: This sets currency {currency}, time zone {tz}, and {tax} invoices.
english: This sets currency {currency}, time zone {tz}, and {tax} invoices.
arabic: يحدد هذا العملة {currency} والمنطقة الزمنية {tz} وفواتير {tax}.
spanish: Configura la moneda {currency}, la zona horaria {tz} y las facturas con {tax}.
portuguese: Isso define faturas de moeda {currency}, fuso horário {tz} e {tax}.
chinese: 将设定货币 {currency}、时区 {tz} 与 {tax} 发票。

key: This stay is {v0}, so there is nothing to check out.
english: This stay is {v0}, so there is nothing to check out.
arabic: حالة هذه الإقامة {v0}، فلا توجد مغادرة لتسجيلها.
spanish: Esta estancia está en estado {v0}; no hay una salida que registrar.
portuguese: Esta estadia é {v0}, portanto não há nada para fazer check-out.

key: This step is not finished yet.
english: This step is not finished yet.
spanish: Este paso aún no está completo.
portuguese: Esta etapa ainda não foi concluída.

key: This step needs the AI. Add an AI key in Settings → AI assistant.
english: This step needs the AI. Add an AI key in Settings → AI assistant.
chinese: 此步骤需要 AI。请在设置 → AI 助手中添加密钥。

key: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
english: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
arabic: هذا النوع ممتلئ الليلة - جرّب نوع غرفة آخر.
spanish: No hay disponibilidad de este tipo de habitación para esta noche. Pruebe con otro tipo.
portuguese: Este tipo está lotado esta noite - tente outro tipo de quarto.
chinese: 该房型今晚已满 - 请尝试其他房型。

spanish: Este año frente al año pasado
portuguese: Este ano em comparação com o ano passado

key: Tick Credit allowed and save to bill this company on the city ledger.
english: Tick Credit allowed and save to bill this company on the city ledger.
arabic: حدد «الائتمان مسموح» واحفظ لفوترة هذه الشركة على دفتر المدينة.
spanish: Marque «Crédito permitido» y guarde los cambios para facturar a esta empresa en su cuenta por cobrar.
portuguese: Marque Crédito permitido e salve para faturar esta empresa no city ledger.
chinese: 勾选「允许赊账」并保存，即可将该公司的账单记入应收账户。

key: Tick the confirmation above to continue.
english: Tick the confirmation above to continue.
arabic: ضع علامة على التأكيد أعلاه للمتابعة.
spanish: Marque la confirmación anterior para continuar.
portuguese: Marque a confirmação acima para continuar.
chinese: 请勾选上方确认项后继续。

key: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
english: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
arabic: حدد البنود المنقولة إلى الفاتورة الجديدة.
spanish: Marque las líneas que desea trasladar a la nueva cuenta.
portuguese: Marque as linhas que passam para a nova fatura.
chinese: 勾选要转移到新账单的行。

key: Tick to deactivate; clear to activate
english: Tick to deactivate; clear to activate
arabic: حدد لإلغاء التفعيل؛ أزل التحديد للتفعيل
spanish: Marque para desactivar; desmarque para activar
portuguese: Marque para desativar; limpe para ativar
chinese: 勾选为停用；取消勾选为启用

key: Tick to unpublish; clear to activate at booking
english: Tick to unpublish; clear to activate at booking
arabic: حدد لإلغاء النشر؛ أزل التحديد للتفعيل عند الحجز
spanish: Marque para retirar de publicación; desmarque para ofrecerlo al reservar
portuguese: Marque para cancelar a publicação; claro para ativar na reserva
chinese: 勾选为下架；取消勾选为预订时可用

key: Ticked charge types post to the Company folio on corporate stays. Everything else - and alcohol, always - bills to the guest.
english: Ticked charge types post to the Company folio on corporate stays. Everything else - and alcohol, always - bills to the guest.
arabic: تُرحّل أنواع الرسوم المحددة إلى فاتورة الشركة في إقامات الشركات. كل ما عداها، والكحول دائمًا، يُفوتر على الضيف.
spanish: Los tipos de cargo marcados se registran en el folio de la empresa durante las estancias corporativas. Los demás cargos, y siempre las bebidas alcohólicas, se facturan al huésped.
portuguese: Despesas selecionadas são faturadas na conta da empresa. Todas as demais despesas e bebidas alcoólicas entram na fatura do hóspede.
chinese: 勾选的费用类型在企业住店时记入公司客账。其余费用（以及酒水）始终由客人承担。

key: Ticked charge types post to the Company folio on corporate stays. Everything else bills to the guest.
english: Ticked charge types post to the Company folio on corporate stays. Everything else bills to the guest.
arabic: أنواع الرسوم المحددة تُرحّل إلى حساب الشركة في إقامات الشركات. كل ما عداها يُحمّل على الضيف.
spanish: Los tipos de cargo marcados van a la cuenta de la empresa en estancias corporativas. Todo lo demás se cobra al huésped.
portuguese: Os tipos de lançamento marcados vão para a conta da empresa em estadias corporativas. Todo o resto é cobrado do hóspede.
chinese: 勾选的费用类型在企业住店时记入公司客账。其余费用由客人承担。

key: Tickets by category and priority, open work, SLA breaches and average resolution time.
english: Tickets by category and priority, open work, SLA breaches and average resolution time.
arabic: التذاكر حسب الفئة والأولوية، والعمل المفتوح، وخروقات اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة ومتوسط وقت الحل.
spanish: Tickets por categoría y prioridad, trabajo abierto, incumplimientos de SLA y tiempo medio de resolución.
portuguese: Chamados por categoria e prioridade, pendências, violações de SLA e tempo médio de resolução.
chinese: 按分类与优先级的工单、未结工作、服务时限超时与平均解决时长。

key: Tickets for this printer print on this device's default printer.
english: Tickets for this printer print on this device's default printer.
arabic: تُطبع تذاكر هذه الطابعة على الطابعة الافتراضية لهذا الجهاز.
spanish: Las comandas dirigidas a esta impresora se imprimen en la impresora predeterminada de este dispositivo.
portuguese: As comandas desta impressora são impressas na impressora padrão deste dispositivo.
chinese: 发给该打印机的单据将在本设备的默认打印机上打印。

key: Tickets solved before tracking began show as "Not recorded".
english: Tickets solved before tracking began show as "Not recorded".
arabic: التذاكر التي حُلّت قبل بدء التتبع تظهر كـ «غير مسجل».
spanish: Las solicitudes resueltas antes de iniciar el seguimiento aparecen como «Sin registrar».
portuguese: Chamados resolvidos antes do início do rastreamento aparecem como "Não registrados".
chinese: 追溯开始前已解决的工单显示为「未记录」。

key: Tickets with deadlines (SLA) and who solved what.
english: Tickets with deadlines (SLA) and who solved what.
arabic: التذاكر ومواعيدها (SLA) ومن حلّ كلًا منها.
spanish: Solicitudes con plazos de atención (SLA) y seguimiento de su resolución.
portuguese: Chamados com prazos (SLA) e responsáveis pela resolução.
chinese: 带服务时限的工单及各自解决人。

spanish: Etapa de pago que se completa

key: Tie it to the group staying for the event to bill both on one master folio
english: Tie it to the group staying for the event to bill both on one master folio
arabic: اربطها بالمجموعة المقيمة للمناسبة لفوترة الاثنين على فاتورة رئيسية واحدة
spanish: Vincúlelo al grupo que se aloja para el evento y facture ambos en un folio maestro
portuguese: Vincule-o ao grupo que permanecerá no evento para faturar ambos em um único extrato mestre
chinese: 将其关联参与该活动的团队，即可合并开在一张主客账上

key: Tie this function to a group booking to bill it onto the group's master folio.
english: Tie this function to a group booking to bill it onto the group's master folio.
arabic: اربط هذه المناسبة بحجز مجموعة لفوترتها على الفاتورة الرئيسية للمجموعة.
spanish: Vincule este evento a una reserva de grupo para facturarlo en el folio maestro del grupo.
portuguese: Vincule este evento a uma reserva grupal para faturá-lo no extrato mestre do grupo.
chinese: 将此活动关联团队预订，即可记入团队主客账。

key: Till variance that needs a manager
english: Till variance that needs a manager
spanish: Diferencia de caja que requiere un gerente
portuguese: Diferença de caixa que precisa de um gerente
chinese: 需经理处理的钱箱差异

key: Tills, ledgers, night audit, reports and accounting export.

english: What companies and travel agents owe (the city ledger). A company's guest bill lands here at check-out; the company's payments take it off.
arabic: ما تدين به الشركات ووكلاء السفر (حساب المدينين). فاتورة نزيل الشركة تصل إلى هنا عند المغادرة، ودفعات الشركة تُنقصها.

portuguese: O que empresas e agências de viagem devem (razão de empresas). A conta do hóspede de uma empresa chega aqui no check-out; os pagamentos da empresa a abatem.
chinese: 公司与旅行社欠款（应收账户）。公司客人账单在退房时转入此处，公司付款后冲销。

portuguese: O que você contou e por que é diferente? (obrigatório)

english: What do you want to change?

portuguese: Quanto custa cada quarto por noite e o que o moveu.
chinese: 各客房每晚的价格及变动原因。

key: What each till took, by payment mode.
english: What each till took, by payment mode.
arabic: ما حصّله كل صندوق حسب طريقة الدفع.
spanish: Lo que cobró cada caja, por forma de pago.
portuguese: O que cada caixa levou, por forma de pagamento.
chinese: 各钱箱按支付方式的收款。

key: What everyone at this hotel sees until they customise their own Today.
english: What everyone at this hotel sees until they customise their own Today.

spanish: El diseño que verá el personal del hotel hasta que personalice su propia pantalla Hoy.
portuguese: O que todos neste hotel veem até personalizarem o seu Hoje.
chinese: 本酒店所有人默认看到的今日页，直至其自定义。

english: What guests owe on their bills right now: every charge posted to a guest's folio (room nights, restaurant and laundry charged to the room, extras) less what they paid, advances applied at check-in, and bills moved to a company. Positive means guests owe the hotel.

spanish: Lo que deben los huéspedes en sus cuentas ahora: cada cargo en la cuenta del huésped (noches, restaurante y lavandería cargados a la habitación, extras) menos lo que pagaron, los anticipos aplicados en el check-in y las cuentas pasadas a una empresa. Positivo significa que los huéspedes deben al hotel.
portuguese: O que os hóspedes devem em suas contas agora: cada cobrança lançada na conta do hóspede (diárias, restaurante e lavanderia no quarto, extras) menos o que pagaram, os adiantamentos aplicados no check-in e as contas passadas a uma empresa. Positivo significa que os hóspedes devem ao hotel.
chinese: 客人当前账单欠款：计入客人客账的全部费用（间夜、记入客房的餐饮与洗衣、附加消费）减去已付款、入住时抵扣的预付款及转至公司的账单。正数表示客人欠酒店。

key: What guests pay online when booking on your public page. Existing bookings keep the terms they were made under - a change here only affects new bookings.
english: What guests pay online when booking on your public page. Existing bookings keep the terms they were made under - a change here only affects new bookings.
arabic: ما يدفعه الضيوف عبر الإنترنت عند الحجز من صفحتك العامة. تحتفظ الحجوزات الحالية بشروطها، والتغيير هنا يؤثر على الحجوزات الجديدة فقط.
spanish: Importe que pagan los huéspedes al reservar en su página pública. Las reservas existentes conservan sus condiciones; estos cambios solo se aplican a las nuevas reservas.
portuguese: O que os hóspedes pagam online quando reservam na sua página pública. As reservas existentes mantêm os termos sob os quais foram feitas - uma alteração aqui afeta apenas novas reservas.
chinese: 客人在公开页面预订时的在线支付金额。既有预订保留其原条款 - 此处修改仅影响新预订。

key: What guests see first on the booking page and self check-in. They can still switch. Your own screen language does not change.
english: What guests see first on the booking page and self check-in. They can still switch. Your own screen language does not change.
arabic: ما يراه الضيوف أولاً في صفحة الحجز وتسجيل الوصول الذاتي. يمكنهم تغييره. لا تتغير لغة شاشتك.

portuguese: O que os hóspedes veem primeiro na página de reservas e no check-in online. Eles ainda podem trocar. O idioma da sua própria tela não muda.
chinese: 客人在预订页与自助入住时首先看到的语言。客人仍可切换。你自己的界面语言不受影响。

key: What happens when a captain sends an order to the kitchen.
english: What happens when a captain sends an order to the kitchen.
arabic: ما يحدث عندما يرسل الكابتن طلبًا إلى المطبخ.
spanish: Qué sucede cuando el jefe de servicio envía un pedido a cocina.
portuguese: O que acontece quando um capitão manda um pedido para a cozinha.
chinese: 领班将订单发往厨房时发生什么。

portuguese: Qual é o horário de check-in?
O que é? (por exemplo, guarda-chuva preto)

portuguese: O que é? (Uniformes dos funcionários, Toalhas de piscina…)
chinese: 是什么？（员工制服、泳池毛巾…）

key: What is still owed moves to the other company's account. What {v0} already paid stays here. The bill keeps its number and date, so it ages from when it was raised.
english: What is still owed moves to the other company's account. What {v0} already paid stays here. The bill keeps its number and date, so it ages from when it was raised.

portuguese: O saldo devedor é transferido para a outra empresa. Os valores já pagos por {v0} permanecem nesta conta. A fatura mantém número e data originais.
chinese: 未结余额转入另一公司账户，{v0} 已付款项留在此处。账单保留原编号与日期，账龄自开具日起算。

spanish: Descripción del plato, sección de cocina que lo prepara y costo por porción.
portuguese: O que é, que seção é preparada e quanto custa fazer uma porção.
chinese: 菜品说明、制作部门与每份成本。

portuguese: O que fisicamente deve chegar ao salão e quando.
chinese: 需实际送达宴会厅的物料及时间。

portuguese: O que o preço da placa cobre

key: What they pick is what the kitchen cooks and what the card prints.
english: What they pick is what the kitchen cooks and what the card prints.
arabic: ما يختارونه هو ما يطهوه المطبخ وما يُطبع في القائمة.
spanish: Los platos seleccionados son los que prepara la cocina y aparecen en la carta impresa.
portuguese: O que eles escolhem é o que a cozinha cozinha e o que o cartão imprime.
chinese: 客人所选即厨房所制、菜单卡所打印。

key: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
english: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
arabic: ما هذا المال: مقابل الفاتورة، أو مقدمة، أو تأمين قابل للاسترداد
spanish: Concepto del pago: abono a la cuenta, anticipo de reserva o depósito de garantía reembolsable
portuguese: Identificação do recebimento: quitação da fatura, adiantamento ou depósito caução reembolsável
chinese: 款项性质：抵账单、预付款或可退押金

key: What was actually served. Until this is recorded the bill is a forecast.
english: What was actually served. Until this is recorded the bill is a forecast.
arabic: ما قُدّم فعليًا. حتى يُسجَّل، تبقى الفاتورة تقديرية.
spanish: Lo que se sirvió realmente. Hasta registrarlo, la cuenta es una estimación.
portuguese: Consumo real atendido. Antes deste registro, a fatura é apenas uma estimativa.
chinese: 实际供应数量。在记录前账单仅为预估。

key: What was done? (kept with the ticket)
english: What was done? (kept with the ticket)
spanish: ¿Qué se hizo? (se guarda en la solicitud)
portuguese: O que foi feito? (registrado no chamado)
chinese: 做了哪些处理？（随工单保存）

key: What was quoted, and whether it landed
english: What was quoted, and whether it landed
portuguese: O que foi citado e se chegou

key: What would they like? Tap a dish. Tap it again for one more.
english: What would they like? Tap a dish. Tap it again for one more.
chinese: 要点什么？点击菜品，再点一次再加一份。

key: What would you like to do?
english: What would you like to do?

key: What would you like to do? Tap one.
english: What would you like to do? Tap one.

spanish: Importe acordado para los huéspedes adicionales
portuguese: O que você combinou para eles

key: What you sell and the base rate (BAR) for each.
english: What you sell and the base rate (BAR) for each.
arabic: ما تبيعه والسعر الأساسي (BAR) لكل منها.
spanish: Tipos de habitación que ofrece y la tarifa base (BAR) de cada uno.
portuguese: O que você vende e a taxa básica (BAR) de cada um.
chinese: 你销售的房型及各自的基础价（最优可用房价）。

key: What's still unsettled while the price is being agreed - and what agreeing it would do to the quote.
english: What's still unsettled while the price is being agreed - and what agreeing it would do to the quote.
arabic: ما لم يُحسم بعد أثناء الاتفاق على السعر، وأثر الاتفاق عليه في عرض السعر.
spanish: Lo que aún está pendiente de acordar y su posible efecto en la cotización.
portuguese: O que ainda não está definido enquanto o preço está sendo acordado - e o que isso afetaria a cotação.
chinese: 价格洽谈期间仍未结清的内容，以及确认后对报价的影响。

key: WhatsApp and AI chat text is cleared nightly; who, when and delivery status stay. 0 keeps them.
english: WhatsApp and AI chat text is cleared nightly; who, when and delivery status stay. 0 keeps them.
arabic: يُمسح نص محادثات WhatsApp والذكاء الاصطناعي كل ليلة، ويبقى المرسل والوقت وحالة التسليم. 0 يحتفظ بها.
spanish: El texto de WhatsApp y conversaciones de IA se elimina cada noche; se conservan participantes, fechas y estado de entrega. 0 = conservar el texto.
portuguese: O texto do bate-papo do WhatsApp e da IA ​​é apagado todas as noites; quem, quando e status de entrega permanecem. 0 os mantém.
chinese: WhatsApp 与 AI 对话文本每晚清除；操作人、时间与投递状态保留。0 表示永久保留。

key: WhatsApp the guest when a charge is posted to the room
english: WhatsApp the guest when a charge is posted to the room
arabic: إرسال رسالة واتساب للنزيل عند قيد رسوم على الغرفة
spanish: Enviar un WhatsApp al huésped cuando se carga algo a la habitación
portuguese: Enviar WhatsApp ao hóspede quando uma cobrança é lançada no quarto
chinese: 向客房入账费用时通过 WhatsApp 通知客人

key: WhatsApp the quotation summary to the guest
english: WhatsApp the quotation summary to the guest
arabic: إرسال ملخص عرض السعر إلى الضيف عبر WhatsApp
spanish: Enviar al huésped el resumen de la cotización por WhatsApp
portuguese: Envie por WhatsApp o resumo do orçamento para o hóspede
chinese: 通过 WhatsApp 向客人发送报价摘要

key: When & how the room is set
english: When & how the room is set
portuguese: Quando e como a quarto está arrumada

key: When a captain sends an order, the kitchen ticket prints immediately and the order shows on the kitchen display as started. Leave this off if the kitchen must press Start.
english: When a captain sends an order, the kitchen ticket prints immediately and the order shows on the kitchen display as started. Leave this off if the kitchen must press Start.
arabic: عند إرسال الطلب تُطبع تذكرة المطبخ فوراً ويظهر الطلب على شاشة المطبخ كأنه بدأ. اتركه مطفأ إذا كان على المطبخ ضغط بدء.
spanish: Cuando el jefe de servicio envía un pedido, la comanda se imprime de inmediato y aparece como iniciada en la pantalla de cocina. Desactive esta opción si el personal de cocina debe pulsar «Iniciar».
portuguese: Ao enviar um pedido, a comanda de cozinha é impressa imediatamente e o pedido é exibido no display da cozinha como iniciado. Deixe desativado se a cozinha precisar clicar em Iniciar.
chinese: 领班下单后厨房单立即打印，订单在厨房屏显示为已开始。若需厨房手动点击开始，请关闭此项。

key: When a checkout clean is done, a supervisor inspection task is created. Passing it marks the room Ready.
english: When a checkout clean is done, a supervisor inspection task is created. Passing it marks the room Ready.
arabic: عند اكتمال تنظيف المغادرة، تُنشأ مهمة فحص للمشرف. اعتمادها يجعل الغرفة جاهزة.
spanish: Al completar una limpieza por salida se crea una tarea de inspección. Al aprobarla, la habitación queda Lista.
portuguese: Quando a limpeza de check-out é concluída, uma tarefa de inspeção do supervisor é criada. Ao ser aprovada, o quarto é marcado como Pronto.
chinese: 退房清洁完成后会创建主管查房任务。通过后客房标记为就绪。

key: When a credit company has no billing rules
english: When a credit company has no billing rules
arabic: عندما لا تملك شركة الائتمان قواعد فوترة
spanish: Cuando una empresa con crédito no tiene reglas de facturación
portuguese: Quando uma empresa de crédito não tem regras de cobrança
chinese: 赊账公司无账单规则时

key: When a no-show paid more than the fee
english: When a no-show paid more than the fee
arabic: عندما يكون من لم يحضر قد دفع أكثر من الرسوم
spanish: Cuando un no presentado pagó más que el cargo
portuguese: Quando um não comparecimento pagou mais que a taxa
chinese: 未到店客人付款超过费用时

key: When a stay's rate changes after nights are charged
english: When a stay's rate changes after nights are charged
arabic: عند تغيّر سعر الإقامة بعد احتساب الليالي
spanish: Cuando cambia la tarifa de una estancia con noches ya cargadas
portuguese: Quando a tarifa de uma estadia muda depois de noites lançadas
chinese: 已计间夜后住店价格变动时

key: When forecast occupancy for a date crosses a threshold, quotes carry the premium automatically and no rate may sell below the hurdle. A room-type tier beats the all-types tier. Guardrails (floor and ceiling) only bound rates set through set_room_rate - Kamra Agent, MCP or the API - not these premiums, staff seasons or quotes.
english: When forecast occupancy for a date crosses a threshold, quotes carry the premium automatically and no rate may sell below the hurdle. A room-type tier beats the all-types tier. Guardrails (floor and ceiling) only bound rates set through set_room_rate - Kamra Agent, MCP or the API - not these premiums, staff seasons or quotes.
arabic: عندما يتجاوز الإشغال المتوقع لتاريخ ما حدًا معينًا، تتضمن عروض الأسعار العلاوة تلقائيًا ولا يُباع أي سعر دون الحد الأدنى. مستوى نوع الغرفة يتقدم على مستوى كل الأنواع. الضوابط (الحد الأدنى والأعلى) تقيّد فقط الأسعار المحددة عبر set_room_rate (Kamra Agent أو MCP أو API)، وليس هذه العلاوات أو مواسم الموظفين أو عروض الأسعار.
spanish: Cuando la ocupación prevista supera un umbral, se aplica un recargo automático a las cotizaciones y una tarifa mínima de venta. El nivel específico de un tipo de habitación tiene prioridad sobre el general. Los límites mínimo y máximo solo se aplican a tarifas establecidas mediante set_room_rate (Kamra Agent, MCP o API), no a estos recargos, temporadas del personal ni cotizaciones.
portuguese: Quando a ocupação prevista para uma data ultrapassa um limite, as cotações carregam o prêmio automaticamente e nenhuma tarifa pode ser vendida abaixo da barreira. Uma camada de tipo de quarto supera a camada de todos os tipos. As proteções (piso e teto) vinculam apenas as taxas definidas por meio de set_room_rate - Agente Kamra, MCP ou API - e não esses prêmios, temporadas de funcionários ou cotações.
chinese: 当某日预测入住率跨过阈值时，报价自动包含溢价，且任何价格不得低于阶梯低价。房型档优先于全房型档。价格护栏（上下限）仅约束通过 set_room_rate 设置的价格（Kamra 智能助手、MCP 或 API），不约束这些溢价、人工季节价或报价。

key: When it is served - kitchen holds later courses until the table is ready
english: When it is served - kitchen holds later courses until the table is ready
arabic: موعد التقديم: يؤجل المطبخ الأطباق اللاحقة حتى تجهز الطاولة
spanish: Momento de servicio: la cocina retiene los tiempos posteriores hasta que la mesa esté lista
portuguese: Quando é servido - a cozinha mantém os pratos posteriores até a mesa estar pronta
chinese: 上菜时机 - 厨房会等到桌台就绪再上后续菜序

key: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.
english: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.
arabic: عند الإيقاف، تُختصر أرقام الهاتف والهوية في نتائج الأدوات إلى آخر أربعة أرقام قبل خروجها من Kamra.
spanish: Cuando está desactivado, los números de teléfono y de identificación en los resultados de la herramienta se reducen a los últimos cuatro dígitos antes de salir de Kamra.
portuguese: Quando desativado, os números de telefone e de identificação nos resultados da ferramenta são reduzidos para os últimos quatro dígitos antes de saírem do Kamra.
chinese: 关闭时，工具结果中的电话与证件号在离开 Kamra 前会截断为后四位。

key: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
english: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
arabic: عند دفع النزيل، يُسجَّل العربون هنا تلقائيًا.
spanish: Cuando el huésped pague, el anticipo se registrará aquí automáticamente.
portuguese: Quando o hóspede paga, o depósito é lançado aqui automaticamente.
chinese: 客人付款后，押金会自动入账至此。

key: When the night audit turns an arrival that never came into a No Show, and who pays for it. The fee itself is the no-show charge under Stay policies.
english: When the night audit turns an arrival that never came into a No Show, and who pays for it. The fee itself is the no-show charge under Stay policies.
arabic: متى يحوّل التدقيق الليلي الوصول الذي لم يحدث إلى عدم حضور، ومن يدفع. الرسوم نفسها هي رسوم عدم الحضور في سياسات الإقامة.
spanish: Cuándo la auditoría marca como no presentada una llegada que no ocurrió y quién paga. El cargo se configura en Políticas de estancia.
portuguese: Quando a auditoria noturna transforma uma chegada que nunca chegou em No Show, e quem paga por isso. A taxa em si é a cobrança de não comparecimento de acordo com as políticas de estadia.
chinese: 夜审将未到店的到店记录转为未到店时，以及由谁承担费用。费用本身按住店政策中的未到店收费执行。

key: When the scheduler closes the business date. It runs on the property's time zone (Property settings) and closes one day per run.
english: When the scheduler closes the business date. It runs on the property's time zone (Property settings) and closes one day per run.
arabic: متى يغلق المجدول تاريخ العمل. يعمل حسب المنطقة الزمنية للمنشأة (إعدادات المنشأة) ويغلق يومًا واحدًا في كل تشغيل.
spanish: Cuándo el programador cierra la fecha operativa. Usa la zona horaria de la propiedad (ajustes de Propiedad) y cierra un día por ejecución.
portuguese: Quando o agendador fecha a data contábil. Usa o fuso horário da propriedade (configurações da Propriedade) e fecha um dia por execução.
chinese: 计划任务关闭营业日的时间。按酒店时区（酒店设置）运行，每次关闭一天。

key: Where a ticket goes if this printer fails.
english: Where a ticket goes if this printer fails.
arabic: وجهة التذكرة إذا تعطلت هذه الطابعة.
spanish: Impresora a la que se enviará la comanda si esta falla.
portuguese: Para onde vai a comanda se esta impressora falhar.
chinese: 此打印机故障时单据的备用去向。

key: Which bookings show against a table on the POS floor.
english: Which bookings show against a table on the POS floor.
arabic: الحجوزات التي تظهر على الطاولة في مخطط POS.
spanish: Reservas que aparecen asociadas a una mesa en el punto de venta.
portuguese: Quais reservas são exibidas em uma mesa no PDV.
chinese: 餐饮收银桌台图上显示哪些预订。

key: Which guest is the charge for?
english: Which guest is the charge for?
chinese: 这笔费用属于哪位客人？

key: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
english: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
arabic: أي قاعة - متاحة لهذه التواريخ والساعات
spanish: Salones disponibles para estas fechas y horarios
portuguese: Qual salão - gratuito nessas datas e horários
chinese: 哪个宴会厅 - 这些日期与时段可用

key: Which KOT this item prints to
english: Which KOT this item prints to
arabic: أمر المطبخ الذي يُطبع عليه هذا الصنف
spanish: Comanda en la que se imprime este artículo
portuguese: Para qual KOT este item é impresso
chinese: 此项目打印到哪张厨房单

key: Which printer gets which KOTs. Two restaurants can share a kitchen printer, and the bar's drinks can print at the bar. With no printers here, each till prints its own KOTs.
english: Which printer gets which KOTs. Two restaurants can share a kitchen printer, and the bar's drinks can print at the bar. With no printers here, each till prints its own KOTs.
arabic: أي طابعة تستقبل أي أوامر مطبخ (أمر المطبخ). يمكن لمطعمين مشاركة طابعة مطبخ، ويمكن طباعة مشروبات البار في البار. إذا لم تكن هناك طابعات، يطبع كل صندوق أوامر المطبخ الخاصة به.
spanish: Qué impresora recibe cada comanda. Dos restaurantes pueden compartir una impresora de cocina, y las bebidas del bar pueden imprimirse en la impresora del bar. Si no hay impresoras configuradas, cada caja imprime sus propias comandas.
portuguese: Qual impressora recebe quais KOTs. Dois restaurantes podem compartilhar uma impressora de cozinha e as bebidas do bar podem ser impressas no bar. Sem impressoras aqui, cada caixa imprime seus próprios KOTs.
chinese: 各打印机接收哪些厨房单。两家餐厅可共用一台厨房打印机，酒吧饮品可在酒吧打印。此处未配置打印机时，各收银台自行打印厨房单。

key: Which rooms are ready, which are dirty, and what housekeeping tasks are open?
english: Which rooms are ready, which are dirty, and what housekeeping tasks are open?
chinese: 哪些客房已就绪、哪些待清洁，还有哪些未结客房任务？

key: Which station prints which tickets, and where bills print.
english: Which station prints which tickets, and where bills print.
arabic: أي محطة تطبع أي تذاكر، وأين تُطبع الفواتير.
spanish: Defina qué estación imprime cada comanda y dónde se imprimen las cuentas.
portuguese: Qual estação imprime quais comandas e onde as faturas são impressas.
chinese: 各工作站打印哪些单据，以及账单在哪里打印。

key: Which system is this export from?
english: Which system is this export from?
portuguese: De qual sistema é essa exportação?
chinese: 此导出文件来自哪个系统？

key: Which waitlisted guests can I now give a room?
english: Which waitlisted guests can I now give a room?
arabic: أي ضيوف قائمة الانتظار يمكنني الآن منحهم غرفة؟
spanish: ¿A qué huéspedes en lista de espera puedo asignar ahora una habitación?
portuguese: A quais hóspedes da lista de espera posso dar um quarto agora?
chinese: 现在可以给哪些候补客人分配客房？

spanish: Quién lo acordó y por qué (obligatorio)

key: Who approves an allowance the desk asks for. Until approved it stays off the bill. A manager approves on the spot with their PIN, or later from Allowances to approve. AI agents can ask, never approve.
english: Who approves an allowance the desk asks for. Until approved it stays off the bill. A manager approves on the spot with their PIN, or later from Allowances to approve. AI agents can ask, never approve.
arabic: من يوافق على خصم يطلبه الاستقبال. لا يدخل الفاتورة حتى تتم الموافقة. يوافق المدير فورًا برمز PIN الخاص به، أو لاحقًا من خصومات بانتظار الموافقة. وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي يمكنهم الطلب، ولا يمكنهم الموافقة أبدًا.
spanish: Quién aprueba un ajuste que pide la recepción. Hasta que se aprueba no entra en la cuenta. Un gerente lo aprueba en el momento con su PIN, o después desde Ajustes por aprobar. Los agentes de IA pueden pedirlo, nunca aprobarlo.
portuguese: Quem aprova um abatimento solicitado pela recepção. Até a aprovação, o item fica fora da fatura. Um gerente aprova na hora com seu PIN, ou depois em Abatimentos a aprovar. Agentes de IA nunca podem aprovar.
chinese: 前台申请的备用额由谁批准。批准前不计入账单。经理可当场用 PIN 批准，或稍后在「待批准备用额」中处理。AI 智能体可申请，但永不批准。

key: Who are you looking for? Type the guest's name, room number or booking number.
english: Who are you looking for? Type the guest's name, room number or booking number.
chinese: 要查找谁？请输入客人姓名、房号或预订号。

key: Who brings the business - revenue and share by channel.
english: Who brings the business - revenue and share by channel.
arabic: مصادر الأعمال: الإيرادات والحصة حسب القناة.
spanish: Origen del negocio: ingresos y participación por canal.
portuguese: Quem traz o negócio - receita e share por canal.
chinese: 业务来源 - 按渠道统计收入与占比。

key: Who can sign in, what each person can do and which properties they reach.
english: Who can sign in, what each person can do and which properties they reach.
arabic: من يمكنه تسجيل الدخول، وما يمكن لكل شخص فعله، والعقارات التي يصل إليها.
spanish: Quién puede iniciar sesión, qué puede hacer cada persona y a qué alojamientos tiene acceso.
portuguese: Quem pode entrar, o que cada pessoa pode fazer e quais imóveis alcança.
chinese: 谁可登录、各自权限及可访问的酒店。

key: Who is arriving today, and are their rooms ready?
english: Who is arriving today, and are their rooms ready?
arabic: من سيصل اليوم، وهل غرفهم جاهزة؟
spanish: ¿Quién llega hoy y están listas sus habitaciones?
portuguese: Quem chega hoje e seus quartos estão prontos?
chinese: 今日谁到店，客房是否已就绪？

key: Who is checking in? Tap their name, or type a name, room or booking number.
english: Who is checking in? Tap their name, or type a name, room or booking number.
chinese: 谁要入住？点击姓名，或输入姓名、房号或预订号。

key: Who is checking out? People leaving today are at the top.
english: Who is checking out? People leaving today are at the top.
chinese: 谁要退房？今日离店客人显示在最上方。

key: Who is it for? Tap a guest in a room, or a table or takeaway.
english: Who is it for? Tap a guest in a room, or a table or takeaway.
chinese: 为谁下单？点击在住客人、桌台或外带。

key: Who is leaving today and what does each still owe?
english: Who is leaving today and what does each still owe?
arabic: من سيغادر اليوم وكم يدين كل منهم؟
spanish: ¿Quién se va hoy y cuánto debe cada uno?
portuguese: Quem vai embora hoje e o que cada um ainda deve?
chinese: 今日谁离店，各自还欠多少？

key: Who pays what on a credit company's stay when that company has no billing rules of its own. A company's own rules always win, and liquor never bills to a company.
english: Who pays what on a credit company's stay when that company has no billing rules of its own. A company's own rules always win, and liquor never bills to a company.
arabic: من يدفع ماذا في إقامة شركة ائتمان عندما لا تملك الشركة قواعد فوترة خاصة. قواعد الشركة الخاصة لها الأولوية دائمًا، والكحول لا يُفوتر على الشركة أبدًا.
spanish: Distribución de cargos en estancias a crédito cuando la empresa no tiene reglas propias. Las reglas de la empresa tienen prioridad y las bebidas alcohólicas nunca se facturan a la empresa.
portuguese: Quem paga o quê na estadia de uma empresa de crédito quando essa empresa não possui regras próprias de cobrança. As próprias regras de uma empresa sempre vencem, e as bebidas alcoólicas nunca são cobradas de uma empresa.
chinese: 赊账公司住店在该公司无自身账单规则时的费用归属。公司自身规则始终优先，酒水永不记入公司。

key: Who signed in to and out of Kamra, newest first.
english: Who signed in to and out of Kamra, newest first.
arabic: من سجل الدخول إلى كمرة والخروج منها، الأحدث أولا.
spanish: Inicios y cierres de sesión en Kamra, del más reciente al más antiguo.
portuguese: Quem entrou e saiu do Kamra, o mais novo primeiro.
chinese: Kamra 的登录与退出记录，最新在前。

key: Whose booking is it? Today's arrivals are below, or type a name or booking number.
english: Whose booking is it? Today's arrivals are below, or type a name or booking number.
chinese: 是谁的预订？今日到店列于下方，或输入姓名/预订号。

key: Why (e.g. checked in the wrong guest)
english: Why (e.g. checked in the wrong guest)
spanish: Motivo (p. ej., se registró la entrada del huésped equivocado)
chinese: 原因（例如为错误的客人办理了入住）

key: Why (e.g. checked out the wrong room)
english: Why (e.g. checked out the wrong room)
spanish: Motivo (p. ej., se registró la salida de la habitación equivocada)
chinese: 原因（例如为错误的客房办理了退房）

key: Why (e.g. guest gave the wrong room number)
english: Why (e.g. guest gave the wrong room number)
arabic: السبب (مثلًا: أعطى الضيف رقم غرفة خطأ)
spanish: Motivo (p. ej., el huésped dio un número de habitación equivocado)
portuguese: Motivo (ex.: o hóspede deu o número de quarto errado)
chinese: 原因（例如客人提供错误房号）

key: Why (shown to whoever tries to bill it)
english: Why (shown to whoever tries to bill it)
spanish: Motivo (se muestra a quien intente facturarle)
portuguese: Motivo (mostrado a quem tentar faturar nela)
chinese: 原因（向尝试开票者显示）

key: Why is the blacklist being lifted?
english: Why is the blacklist being lifted?
portuguese: Por que a lista negra está sendo levantada?

key: Why is this guest being blacklisted?
english: Why is this guest being blacklisted?
arabic: لماذا يُضاف هذا الضيف إلى القائمة السوداء؟
spanish: ¿Por qué se bloquea a este huésped?
portuguese: Por que este hóspede está sendo colocado na lista restrita?
chinese: 为何将该客人列入黑名单？

spanish: Wifi e información de la estancia

key: Without the booking page, bookings come from the front desk and your channels.
english: Without the booking page, bookings come from the front desk and your channels.
arabic: بدون صفحة الحجز، تأتي الحجوزات من الاستقبال وقنواتك.
spanish: Sin la página de reservas, las reservas llegan desde la recepción y sus canales.
portuguese: Sem a página de reservas, as reservas vêm da recepção e dos seus canais.
chinese: 关闭预订页时，预订来自前台与各渠道。

key: Write the reason for the override to continue.
english: Write the reason for the override to continue.
spanish: Indique el motivo de la excepción para continuar.
portuguese: Escreva o motivo para a substituição continuar.
chinese: 请填写覆盖原因后继续。

arabic: البريد الإلكتروني أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.
البريد الإلكتروني أو اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.
spanish: Correo electrónico, nombre de usuario o contraseña incorrectos.
portuguese: E-mail, nome de usuário ou senha incorretos.
chinese: 邮箱、用户名或密码错误。

key: You already have an API key. Rotate it below to get a fresh key + secret.
english: You already have an API key. Rotate it below to get a fresh key + secret.
arabic: لديك مفتاح API بالفعل. جدّده أدناه للحصول على مفتاح وسر جديدين.
spanish: Ya tiene una clave de API. Renuévela abajo para obtener una clave y un secreto nuevos.
portuguese: Você já tem uma chave de API. Gire abaixo para obter uma nova chave + segredo.
chinese: 你已有 API 密钥。在下方轮换可获取新的密钥与密文。

key: You approve this as a supervisor.
english: You approve this as a supervisor.
arabic: أنت توافق على هذا بصفتك مشرفًا.

key: You are using the hotel's default layout.
english: You are using the hotel's default layout.
spanish: Estás utilizando el diseño predeterminado del hotel.
portuguese: Você está usando o layout padrão do hotel.
chinese: 你正在使用酒店默认布局。

key: You are using the standard layout.
english: You are using the standard layout.
portuguese: Você está usando o layout padrão.

key: You are using your own layout.
english: You are using your own layout.
portuguese: Você está usando seu próprio layout.
chinese: 你正在使用自己的布局。

key: You can change your name and job title. Ask another admin to change your access.
english: You can change your name and job title. Ask another admin to change your access.
arabic: يمكنك تغيير اسمك ومسماك الوظيفي. اطلب من مسؤول آخر تغيير صلاحياتك.
spanish: Puede cambiar su nombre y su cargo. Pida a otro administrador que cambie su acceso.
portuguese: Você pode alterar seu nome e cargo. Peça a outro administrador para alterar seu acesso.
chinese: 你可修改姓名与职位。权限变更请联系其他管理员。

key: You can change your name. Ask another admin to change your job title or access.
english: You can change your name. Ask another admin to change your job title or access.
arabic: يمكنك تغيير اسمك. اطلب من مسؤول آخر تغيير مسماك الوظيفي أو صلاحياتك.
spanish: Puede cambiar su nombre. Pida a otro administrador que cambie su cargo o su acceso.
portuguese: Você pode alterar seu nome. Peça a outro administrador para alterar seu cargo ou acesso.
chinese: 你可修改姓名。职位或权限变更请联系其他管理员。

key: You can still check out. These are not on the guest's bill: when they are posted later they land on the departed stay's folio and have to be collected separately. To add them now, go back to the Bill step.
english: You can still check out. These are not on the guest's bill: when they are posted later they land on the departed stay's folio and have to be collected separately. To add them now, go back to the Bill step.
arabic: يمكنك تسجيل المغادرة. هذه غير مضافة إلى فاتورة النزيل: إذا أُضيفت لاحقًا فستذهب إلى حساب الإقامة المنتهية ويجب تحصيلها بشكل منفصل. لإضافتها الآن، ارجع إلى خطوة الفاتورة.
spanish: Todavía puede registrar la salida. Estos cargos no están incluidos en la cuenta del huésped. Si se registran más adelante, se cargarán al folio de la estancia finalizada y deberán cobrarse por separado. Para agregarlos ahora, vuelva al paso «Cuenta».
portuguese: Check-out autorizado. Itens não lançados na fatura do hóspede irão para o extrato da estadia encerrada para cobrança posterior. Para incluir agora, retorne à etapa Fatura.
chinese: 仍可退房。这些项不在客人账单上：稍后入账会落在已离店住店的客账中，需单独收取。如需现在加入，请返回账单步骤。

key: You can't change your own access
english: You can't change your own access
spanish: No puede cambiar su propio acceso
portuguese: Você não pode alterar seu próprio acesso
chinese: 你无法修改自己的权限

key: You close it at the end of your shift with a cash count (Finance, Cashier).
english: You close it at the end of your shift with a cash count (Finance, Cashier).
arabic: تغلقه في نهاية نوبتك بعد عدّ النقد (المالية، أمين الصندوق).
spanish: Lo cierra al final de su turno con un arqueo de caja (Finanzas, Cajero).
portuguese: Você fecha no final do seu turno com uma contagem de caixa (Finanças, Caixa).
chinese: 班次结束时通过现金清点关闭（财务、收银）。

key: You don't have an API key yet. Generate one to call the REST API or connect an agent.
english: You don't have an API key yet. Generate one to call the REST API or connect an agent.
arabic: ليس لديك مفتاح API بعد. أنشئ مفتاحًا لاستدعاء REST API أو ربط وكيل.
spanish: Aún no tiene una clave de API. Genere una para utilizar la API REST o conectar un agente.
portuguese: Você ainda não tem uma chave de API. Gere um para chamar a API REST ou conectar um agente.
chinese: 你还没有 API 密钥。生成后可调用 REST API 或连接智能体。

key: You don't have permission for that, or your session ended - sign in again if this persists.
english: You don't have permission for that, or your session ended - sign in again if this persists.
arabic: ليست لديك صلاحية لذلك، أو انتهت جلستك. سجّل الدخول مجددًا إذا استمرت المشكلة.
spanish: No tiene permiso para esta acción o su sesión terminó. Si el problema continúa, vuelva a iniciar sesión.
portuguese: Você não tem permissão para isso ou sua sessão foi encerrada. Faça login novamente se o problema persistir.
chinese: 你无此权限，或会话已结束 - 若持续出现请重新登录。

key: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
english: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
arabic: يبدو أنك غير متصل. تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مرة أخرى.
spanish: Parece que no tiene conexión. Revise su conexión e inténtelo de nuevo.
portuguese: Parece que você está offline. Verifique sua conexão e tente novamente.
chinese: 你似乎已离线。请检查网络后重试。

spanish: Ya completaste el registro de entrada en línea

key: Your accounts' ledger code. Each line keeps the GL code it was posted with.
english: Your accounts' ledger code. Each line keeps the GL code it was posted with.
arabic: رمز الحساب في دفاتر حساباتك. يحتفظ كل سطر برمز الحساب الذي قُيّد به.
spanish: El código de cuenta de su contabilidad. Cada línea conserva la cuenta contable con la que se registró.
portuguese: O código da conta na sua contabilidade. Cada linha mantém a conta contábil com que foi lançada.
chinese: 你的账户台账代码。每行保留入账时的总账代码。

key: Your AI provider acts as you at
english: Your AI provider acts as you at
arabic: يعمل مزوّد الذكاء الاصطناعي باسمك في
spanish: Su proveedor de IA actúa con su identidad en
portuguese: Seu provedor de IA atua com sua identidade em
chinese: 你的 AI 提供商以此身份代表你：

key: Your AI provider will act as {0}, within your role. Prices, taxes and availability stay in Kamra. Every action is recorded under your name in the Activity log.
english: Your AI provider will act as {0}, within your role. Prices, taxes and availability stay in Kamra. Every action is recorded under your name in the Activity log.
arabic: سيعمل مزوّد الذكاء الاصطناعي باسم {0} وضمن صلاحيات دورك. تبقى الأسعار والضرائب والتوافر في Kamra. يُسجّل كل إجراء باسمك في سجل النشاط.
spanish: Su proveedor de IA actuará como {0}, con los permisos de su rol. Los precios, los impuestos y la disponibilidad se gestionan en Kamra. Cada acción se registra con su nombre en el registro de Actividad.
portuguese: Seu provedor de IA atuará como {0}, com as permissões da sua função. Preços, impostos e disponibilidade continuam no Kamra. Cada ação é registrada com seu nome no registro de Atividade.
chinese: 你的 AI 提供商将以 {0} 的身份、在你的角色范围内操作。价格、税费与可用房始终由 Kamra 计算。所有操作都以你的名义记入活动日志。

spanish: Su IA, actuando con su identidad
chinese: 你的 AI，以你的身份操作

key: Your API key, the REST surface, and how to connect AI agents. Every call runs with your roles and lands in the audit log.
english: Your API key, the REST surface, and how to connect AI agents. Every call runs with your roles and lands in the audit log.
arabic: مفتاح API الخاص بك، وواجهة REST، وكيفية ربط وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي. كل استدعاء يعمل بصلاحياتك ويُسجَّل في سجل التدقيق.
spanish: Su clave de API, los servicios REST y la conexión de agentes de IA. Cada solicitud usa sus permisos y queda en el registro de auditoría.
portuguese: Sua chave de API, a superfície REST e como conectar agentes de IA. Cada chamada é executada com suas funções e chega ao log de auditoria.
chinese: 你的 API 密钥、REST 接口以及如何连接 AI 智能体。每次调用都以你的角色运行并记入审计日志。

key: Your chats will show up here.
english: Your chats will show up here.

key: Your configured endpoint processes chat messages and tool results under that provider's terms and region.
english: Your configured endpoint processes chat messages and tool results under that provider's terms and region.
arabic: تعالج نقطة النهاية التي ضبطتها رسائل المحادثة ونتائج الأدوات وفق شروط ذلك المزوّد ومنطقته.
spanish: El servicio configurado procesa los mensajes y resultados de herramientas según las condiciones y región de ese proveedor.
portuguese: Seu endpoint configurado processa mensagens de chat e resultados de ferramentas de acordo com os termos e a região desse provedor.
chinese: 你配置的端点按该提供商的服务条款与区域处理对话消息与工具结果。

key: Your details and signature form the guest register required by law.
english: Your details and signature form the guest register required by law.
arabic: تشكّل بياناتك وتوقيعك سجل النزلاء المطلوب نظامًا.
spanish: Tus datos y tu firma formarán parte del registro de huéspedes exigido por ley.
portuguese: Seus dados e assinatura formam o registro de hóspedes exigido por lei.
chinese: 你的信息与签名构成法律要求的客人登记。

key: Your ID photo is kept with the guest register the hotel is required by law to maintain. Only hotel staff can see it.
english: Your ID photo is kept with the guest register the hotel is required by law to maintain. Only hotel staff can see it.
arabic: تُحفظ صورة هويتك مع سجل النزلاء الذي يلتزم الفندق نظامًا بالاحتفاظ به. لا يطّلع عليها إلا موظفو الفندق.
spanish: El hotel conservará una copia de tu documento de identidad en el registro de huéspedes que debe mantener por ley. Solo el personal del hotel podrá verla.
portuguese: Sua foto de identificação será mantida no registro de hóspedes que o hotel é obrigado por lei a manter. Somente os funcionários do hotel podem vê-lo.
chinese: 你的证件照片随法律要求酒店保存的客人登记簿一并留存，仅酒店员工可见。

key: Your ID photo is used only to confirm your identity at arrival, and is permanently deleted when you check out. Only hotel staff can see it.
english: Your ID photo is used only to confirm your identity at arrival, and is permanently deleted when you check out. Only hotel staff can see it.
arabic: تُستخدم صورة هويتك فقط للتحقق من هويتك عند الوصول، وتُحذف نهائيًا عند المغادرة. لا يطّلع عليها إلا موظفو الفندق.
spanish: La foto de tu documento de identidad solo se usa para confirmar tu identidad al llegar y se elimina de forma permanente cuando salgas del hotel. Solo el personal del hotel podrá verla.
portuguese: A foto do seu documento é usada apenas para confirmar sua identidade na chegada e é excluída permanentemente no check-out. Somente a equipe do hotel pode visualizá-la.
chinese: 你的证件照片仅用于到店时确认身份，退房时永久删除。仅酒店员工可见。

arabic: الجهة المختصة بحماية البيانات في بلدك
spanish: la autoridad local de protección de datos
portuguese: a sua autoridade local de proteção de dados
chinese: 你当地的数据保护机构

key: your name and contact details to make and manage this booking and reach you about it
english: your name and contact details to make and manage this booking and reach you about it
arabic: اسمك وبيانات التواصل لإجراء هذا الحجز وإدارته والتواصل معك بشأنه
spanish: Su nombre y datos de contacto para gestionar esta reserva y comunicarnos con usted sobre ella.
portuguese: seu nome e dados de contato para fazer e gerenciar esta reserva e entrar em contato com você sobre isso
chinese: 你的姓名与联系方式，用于创建和管理本次预订并与你联系

key: Your PIN signs this allowance, like the paper voucher.
english: Your PIN signs this allowance, like the paper voucher.
arabic: رمزك السري هو توقيعك على هذا الخصم، كما في القسيمة الورقية.
spanish: Su PIN firma esta bonificación, como el vale en papel.
portuguese: Seu PIN assina este abatimento, como o comprovante em papel.
chinese: 你的 PIN 即为该备用额的签署，等同纸质凭证。

key: Your profile is erased {months} months after your last stay. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
english: Your profile is erased {months} months after your last stay. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
arabic: يُحذف ملفك بعد {months} شهرًا من آخر إقامة. وتُحفظ الفواتير وفق ما يتطلبه النظام الضريبي.
spanish: Su perfil se elimina {months} meses después de su última estancia. Las facturas se conservan según lo exige la legislación fiscal.
portuguese: Seu perfil é anonimizado {months} meses após a última hospedagem. As faturas são guardadas pelo prazo fiscal legal.
chinese: 你的资料将在最后一次住店后 {months} 个月删除。账单按税法要求保存。

key: Your profile is kept for future stays until you ask for it to be erased. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
english: Your profile is kept for future stays until you ask for it to be erased. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
arabic: يُحفظ ملفك لإقاماتك القادمة حتى تطلب حذفه. وتُحفظ الفواتير وفق ما يتطلبه النظام الضريبي.
spanish: Su perfil se conserva para futuras estancias hasta que solicite su eliminación. Las facturas se conservan según lo exige la legislación fiscal.
portuguese: Seu cadastro permanece ativo para estadias futuras até solicitação de exclusão. As faturas são guardadas pelo prazo fiscal legal.
chinese: 你的资料将留存以备日后住店，直至你要求删除。账单按税法要求保存。

key: Your property is created. These are the things still to do, in any order. Each one links to where you do it.
english: Your property is created. These are the things still to do, in any order. Each one links to where you do it.
arabic: تم إنشاء عقارك. هذه هي المهام المتبقية، بأي ترتيب. كل مهمة تنقلك إلى مكان تنفيذها.
spanish: Su alojamiento ya está creado. Estas son las tareas pendientes; puede completarlas en cualquier orden. Cada una incluye un enlace a la sección correspondiente.
portuguese: Sua propriedade está criada. Estas são as coisas que ainda precisam ser feitas, em qualquer ordem. Cada um está vinculado a onde você faz isso.
chinese: 酒店已创建。以下是待完成事项，顺序不限，每项均可跳转到操作位置。

key: Your property's check-out routine. Tick each one as you go.
english: Your property's check-out routine. Tick each one as you go.
arabic: إجراءات المغادرة في فندقك. ضع علامة على كل خطوة عند إنجازها.
spanish: Rutina de salida del alojamiento. Marque cada paso a medida que lo complete.
portuguese: A rotina de check-out da sua propriedade. Marque cada item conforme conclui.
chinese: 本酒店的退房流程。逐项勾选。

key: Your request goes to the property to confirm.
english: Your request goes to the property to confirm.
spanish: El alojamiento recibirá tu solicitud para confirmar la reserva.
portuguese: O seu pedido vai para a propriedade para confirmação.
chinese: 你的请求将发送至酒店确认。

key: Your role can see the status but not change it.
english: Your role can see the status but not change it.
arabic: دورك يتيح رؤية الحالة دون تغييرها.
spanish: Su rol puede ver el estado pero no cambiarlo.
portuguese: Sua função pode ver o status, mas não alterá-lo.
chinese: 你的角色可查看状态但无法更改。

key: Your role can settle the bill but not check the guest out. Ask Front Desk or a Hotel Admin to press Check out.
english: Your role can settle the bill but not check the guest out. Ask Front Desk or a Hotel Admin to press Check out.
arabic: يمكن لدورك تسوية الفاتورة لكن لا يمكنه تسجيل مغادرة الضيف. اطلب من الاستقبال أو مدير الفندق الضغط على تسجيل المغادرة.
spanish: Su rol permite liquidar la cuenta, pero no registrar la salida. Solicite a Recepción o Administración del hotel que la registre.
portuguese: Seu perfil pode liquidar a fatura, mas não concluir o check-out. Solicite à Recepção ou a um Administrador.
chinese: 你的角色可结清账单但无法办理退房。请让前台或酒店管理员点击「退房」。

spanish: Su rol no permite modificar la configuración de {v0}.
portuguese: Sua função não pode alterar as configurações de {v0}.
chinese: 你的角色无法修改 {v0} 设置。

key: Your role can't change this bill. Ask {who}.
english: Your role can't change this bill. Ask {who}.
arabic: لا يمكن لدورك تعديل هذه الفاتورة. اطلب من {who}.
spanish: Su rol no permite modificar esta cuenta. Solicite ayuda a {who}.
portuguese: Seu perfil não tem permissão para alterar esta fatura. Solicite a {who}.
chinese: 你的角色无法修改此账单。请联系 {who}。

key: Your role can't open a till. Ask {who} to take the money.
english: Your role can't open a till. Ask {who} to take the money.
arabic: لا يمكن لدورك فتح درج نقدي. اطلب من {who} استلام المال.
spanish: Su rol no permite abrir una caja. Solicite a {who} que registre el cobro.
portuguese: Seu perfil não tem permissão para abrir um caixa. Peça a {who} para receber o valor.
chinese: 你的角色无法打开钱箱。请让 {who} 收款。

key: Your role has no settings to manage.
english: Your role has no settings to manage.
spanish: Su rol no tiene configuraciones para administrar.
portuguese: Sua função não tem configurações para gerenciar.
chinese: 你的角色无需管理的设置。

key: Your room types matched to the channel manager's room and rate-plan ids. Every mapped type gets availability and rates pushed; incoming bookings resolve their room through this table.
english: Your room types matched to the channel manager's room and rate-plan ids. Every mapped type gets availability and rates pushed; incoming bookings resolve their room through this table.
arabic: أنواع غرفك مربوطة بمعرّفات الغرف وخطط الأسعار في مدير القنوات. يُرسل التوفر والأسعار لكل نوع مربوط، وتُحدد الحجوزات الواردة غرفتها عبر هذا الجدول.
spanish: Correspondencia entre sus tipos de habitación y los ID de habitación y plan tarifario del gestor de canales. Se envían tarifas y disponibilidad de cada tipo vinculado, y las reservas entrantes se asignan mediante esta tabla.
portuguese: Seus tipos de quarto correspondem aos IDs de quarto e plano de tarifas do channel manager. Cada tipo mapeado obtém disponibilidade e tarifas aumentadas; as reservas recebidas resolvem seus quartos por meio desta tabela.
chinese: 你的房型与渠道管理器的房型和价格方案 ID 的映射。已映射的房型会推送可用房与价格；外部预订通过此表解析房型。

key: Your rooms are held until the advance is received.
english: Your rooms are held until the advance is received.
arabic: غرفك محجوزة لحين استلام الدفعة المقدمة.
spanish: Mantendremos tus habitaciones reservadas hasta recibir el anticipo.
portuguese: Seus quartos ficam retidos até que o adiantamento seja recebido.
chinese: 收到预付款前客房一直保留。

key: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
english: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
arabic: انتهت جلستك. يرجى تسجيل الدخول مرة أخرى.
spanish: Su sesión terminó. Inicie sesión de nuevo.
chinese: 会话已结束，请重新登录。

key: Your session ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
english: Your session ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
arabic: انتهت جلستك. سجّل الدخول للمتابعة من حيث توقفت.
spanish: Su sesión finalizó. Inicie sesión para continuar donde lo dejó.
portuguese: Sua sessão terminou. Faça login para continuar de onde parou.
chinese: 会话已结束。登录后可继续上次进度。

key: Your statement of account is attached.
english: Your statement of account is attached.
portuguese: Segue em anexo o seu extrato de conta.
chinese: 你的账户对账单已附上。

key: Your till is closed. Open it here to take or give back money.
english: Your till is closed. Open it here to take or give back money.
arabic: صندوقك مغلق. افتحه هنا لتحصيل الأموال أو ردها.
spanish: Su caja está cerrada. Ábrala aquí para cobrar o devolver dinero.
portuguese: Seu caixa está fechado. Abra-o aqui para receber ou devolver valores.
chinese: 你的钱箱已关闭。在此打开即可收款或退款。

key: ZATCA Phase 1 ready - QR and XML on every invoice.
english: ZATCA Phase 1 ready - QR and XML on every invoice.
arabic: جاهز للمرحلة الأولى من زاتكا - رمز QR وملف XML على كل فاتورة.
spanish: ZATCA Fase 1 lista: QR y XML en cada factura.
portuguese: Pronto para ZATCA Fase 1 - QR e XML em todas as faturas.
chinese: 已支持 ZATCA 第一阶段 - 每张发票含二维码与 XML。

key: ZATCA: still needed for valid e-invoices - {fields}.
english: ZATCA: still needed for valid e-invoices - {fields}.
arabic: زاتكا: مطلوب لإصدار فواتير إلكترونية صحيحة - {fields}.
spanish: ZATCA: aún es necesario para facturas electrónicas válidas - {fields}.
portuguese: ZATCA: ainda necessário para faturas eletrônicas válidas - {fields}.

key: Zero balance: use Quick check out above, or Check out on the row.
english: Zero balance: use Quick check out above, or Check out on the row.
arabic: رصيد صفري: استخدم المغادرة السريعة أعلاه، أو تسجيل المغادرة في الصف.
spanish: Saldo cero: utilice Salida rápida arriba o Registrar salida en la fila.
portuguese: Saldo zero: use Check-out rápido acima ou Check-out na linha.
chinese: 余额为零：使用上方「快速退房」，或在行上点击「退房」。

spanish: Habitaciones con tarifa cero y de cortesía
portuguese: Quartos cortesia ou com diária zerada
